# AraminConsole

**The zero-dependency, RTL-first admin UI framework that feels like a native app on phones.**
One CSS file, one ES module. Plain HTML, Laravel Blade, Next.js, or anything else.

[![CI](https://github.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-orange.svg)](CHANGELOG.md)
![Dependencies: 0](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)

## Why AraminConsole
- **Zero dependencies, zero build to use it.** Copy `dist/`, add one `<link>` and one `<script type="module">`.
- **RTL first, not RTL patched.** Logical CSS properties only; Persian, Arabic, and English switch live.
- **App-like on phones.** Floating tab bar with FAB, collapsing large titles, bottom sheets, swipe actions, pull-to-refresh, safe areas.
- **Built for Iran.** Rial/Toman, Jalali and Hijri calendars, bank cards and logos, Sheba, national ID and mobile validation, official invoice.
- **Declarative.** `data-ac="…"` attributes start components, even on HTML injected later. Each also has an API on `window.AC`.
- **Modular.** 26 modules; bundle all, some, or lazy-load with `AC.use('maps')`.
- **AI-friendly.** [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), [`llms.txt`](llms.txt), and an [Agent Skill](skills/aramin-console/SKILL.md) let any coding assistant build with it correctly.

## Features and modules
Sizes are minified + gzip, from `dist/modules/modules.json`.

## Quick start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole.git
cp -r AraminConsole/dist ./public/aramin     # dist/ is committed: no npm install needed
```
```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" dir="ltr" data-ac-icons="/aramin/icons.svg">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <script src="/aramin/aramin-console-boot.js"></script>   <!-- saved theme/lang before first paint -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/aramin/aramin-console.min.css">
  <script type="module" src="/aramin/aramin-console.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="ac-card"><div class="ac-card__body">
    <button class="ac-btn ac-btn--primary" type="button"
            onclick="AC.toast({ title: 'Saved', tone: 'success' })">Save</button>
  </div></div>
</body>
</html>
```
Ready-made projects: [`starters/html`](starters/html), [`starters/laravel-blade`](starters/laravel-blade), [`starters/nextjs`](starters/nextjs) ([docs/starters.md](docs/starters.md)). This repository is also a GitHub template: click **Use this template**.

## `data-ac` usage
```html
<div class="ac-segmented" data-ac="segmented">…</div>             <!-- ac:segmented:change -->
<form class="ac-form" data-ac="form">                              <!-- validation + ac:form:submit -->
  <input class="ac-input" name="mobile" data-ac-rules="required|iran-mobile">
</form>
<div class="ac-otp" data-ac="otp" data-length="6"></div>           <!-- ac:otp:complete -->
<div class="ac-chart-slot" data-ac="chart" data-ac-config='{"type":"bar","series":[{"data":[3,5,2]}]}'></div>
<span data-ac="counter" data-to="498601.92" data-decimals="2" data-prefix="$">0</span>
```
```js
import { AC } from './aramin-console.js';           // also available as window.AC
AC.modal.open('#edit');  await AC.confirm({ title: 'Delete?' });  AC.theme.set({ theme: 'dark', accent: 'blue' });
document.addEventListener('ac:form:submit', (e) => e.detail.waitUntil(fetch('/api', { method: 'POST', body: e.detail.formData })));
```
Events always follow `ac:<component>:<event>` and bubble.

## Modular and custom builds
```bash
node scripts/build.mjs --modules=forms,table,chart --out=dist/custom     # core + chosen modules (+ dependencies)
```
```js
await AC.use('maps');                  // lazy-load a module (JS + CSS) on demand
```
Or keep an `aramin.config.json` in your project. Details in [docs/modules.md](docs/modules.md).

## Theming tokens
Everything is a CSS custom property (`--ac-*`); dark mode is a token swap.

| Token | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `--ac-accent`, `--ac-accent-2` | accent and gradient partner |
| `--ac-ink`, `--ac-ink-contrast` | primary buttons, active nav pill |
| `--ac-bg`, `--ac-surface-1/2/3`, `--ac-border` | canvas, cards, hairlines |
| `--ac-text`, `--ac-muted`, `--ac-faint` | text levels |
| `--ac-r-xl`, `--ac-r-pill`, `--ac-control-h` | radius and density |
| `--ac-font` | one font (Vazirmatn) for every script |

Switches on `<html>`: `data-theme="light|dark"`, `data-accent="orange|violet|blue|emerald|rose|amber|slate"`, `data-density="comfortable|compact"`, `data-radius="sharp|default|round"`. Full list: [docs/theming.md](docs/theming.md).

## RTL and i18n
Set `<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">` or call `AC.i18n.set('en')`; it switches `lang`, `dir`, and every `[data-i18n]` text from JSON dictionaries (`AC.i18n.configure({ url: '/i18n/{lang}.json' })`). Latin digits by default, Persian digits with `AC.i18n.setDigits('native')`. See [docs/rtl.md](docs/rtl.md).

## Iranian toolkit
Rial and Toman (`data-ac="money"`, `money-unit`), Jalali and Hijri calendars on `Intl` with no date library, bank cards with Iranian bank logos, Sheba field with bank detection, `iran-mobile` and `iran-national-id` validators, and a print-ready official invoice. See [docs/finance.md](docs/finance.md), [docs/invoice-ir.md](docs/invoice-ir.md), [docs/forms.md](docs/forms.md).

## Browser support
Current Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari (desktop and iOS 16.4+), Samsung Internet. Uses CSS logical properties, `color-mix()`, `:has()`, `dvh`, and the Popover API (with fallback); View Transitions when available.

## Accessibility
Focus traps, roving tabindex, ARIA states, visible focus rings, 44px touch targets, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, and contrast-checked tokens in both themes.

## "Powered by AIR" credit
The base template shows a small `.ac-powered` link («قدرت گرفته از ایر» / "Powered by AIR" / «مدعوم من AIR») to <https://air.co.ir/>: bottom of the rail on desktop, end of content on phones, footer of auth and error pages. The MIT license lets you remove or replace it:
- delete the `<a class="ac-powered" …>` elements in your pages, or
- change the text with the `credit.powered` key in your i18n JSON and the `href` on the link.

We kindly ask that you keep it in the base template and starters you redistribute.

<!-- ===== AGENTS.md ===== -->

# AGENTS.md — AraminConsole operating guide for AI coding assistants

AraminConsole is a zero-dependency, RTL-first admin UI framework: **one CSS file + one ES module** (`window.AC`). No npm runtime deps, no framework, no bundler required to use it. Read this file first, then `docs/CONVENTIONS.md` (the full rulebook) and `llms.txt` (index of every doc). Building an app *with* AraminConsole (not changing it)? Use the Agent Skill in `skills/aramin-console/SKILL.md`.

## Architecture map
```
src/css/            tokens.css base.css layout.css motion.css  +  components/*.css   (design system; tokens = --ac-*)
src/js/core.js      AC namespace, register() auto-init, i18n, theme, format, gesture, trapFocus
src/js/components/  one file per component (register('name', el => …))
src/modules/<name>/ optional feature modules (maps, tickets, files, invoice-ir, …) with module.json
src/modules.json    module manifest (core + shell + overlays + …; sizes written by the build)
src/icons/          icons.txt = Lucide names put into the sprite (dist/icons.svg)
dist/               COMMITTED build output (aramin-console[.min].{css,js}, boot, icons.svg, modules/)
demo/               the live demo app (index.html shell, pages/*.html fragments, auth/, errors/, i18n/{fa,en,ar}.json)
docs/               per-area documentation (also index in llms.txt)
starters/           copy-ready projects: html, laravel-blade, nextjs
skills/aramin-console/  Agent Skill (cheat-sheet + recipes) for building with the framework
tests/              Playwright suites, run through tests/run.mjs
scripts/            build.mjs, minify.mjs, serve.mjs, llms.mjs
```

## Commands
| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Build everything into `dist/` | `npm run build` |
| Dev server (http://localhost:5178/demo/) | `npm run dev` |
| Regenerate `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt` | `npm run llms` |
| Full tests (build + all suites) | `npm test` |
| Selected suites | `node tests/run.mjs shell standalone` (names = files in `tests/` without `.mjs`) |
| Custom build | `node scripts/build.mjs --modules=forms,table --out=dist/custom` |

Always run `npm run build` after touching `src/` and commit the resulting `dist/` (CI checks it; consumers copy `dist/` directly).

## Conventions (non-negotiable)
- **Components** start from `data-ac="name"` and are registered with `register('name', (el) => { …; return destroy; })`. Options come from `data-*` attributes or `data-ac-config='{json}'` through `options(el, defaults)`. Public API goes on `AC.<name>`. Events: `emit(el, 'name:event', detail)` → `ac:name:event` (bubbles).
- **Bundler limits**: only `import {a} from './x.js'`, `export function|const|class`, `export {…}`; no default exports, no circular imports, no npm imports.
- **CSS**: BEM-ish `.ac-block__element--modifier`; state through ARIA/data attributes (`[aria-selected]`, `[data-state]`); **logical properties only** (`margin-inline-start`, `inset-inline-end`, never `left/right`, except JS-measured indicators); directional icons get `.ac-flip-rtl`.
- **Tokens only**: colours, radii, spacing, motion via `var(--ac-*)`. No hex colours. Dark mode is a token swap, not per-component overrides.
- **No inline `style=""`** in markup; no `<script>` inside page fragments.
- **i18n**: Persian text in markup + `data-i18n="area.key"`; attributes via `data-i18n-attr="aria-label:area.key"`. New keys go into **all three** `demo/i18n/{fa,en,ar}.json`.
- **Mobile**: touch targets ≥ 44px (`--ac-touch`), no hover-only affordances, modals become bottom sheets on phones, tables stack (`.ac-table--stack` + `data-label`).
- **Accessibility**: focus trap in overlays, roving tabindex in widgets, visible focus, honour `AC.reducedMotion()`.
- Icons: add the Lucide name to `src/icons/icons.txt`, rebuild, use `<svg class="ac-icon"><use href="#i-name"/></svg>`.

## How to add…
**A component** — `src/js/components/<name>.js` with `register()`; CSS in `src/css/components/<name>.css`; list both in the owning module in `src/modules.json` (or in a module folder); document in the matching `docs/*.md`; add a test in `tests/`; `npm run build`.
**A module** — folder `src/modules/<name>/` with `<name>.js`, `<name>.css`, `module.json` (`description`, `dependencies`); picked up automatically; `node scripts/build.mjs --sync-manifest` records sizes; document in `docs/modules.md`.
**A demo page** — `demo/pages/<name>.html` (fragment shape in `docs/CONVENTIONS.md` §7), rail link `#/<name>`, optional `demo/pages/<name>.js` default export `mount(root, AC)`.

## Do
- Reuse existing atoms (`.ac-card`, `.ac-btn`, `.ac-bento`, `.ac-stat`, …) before inventing classes.
- Keep it dependency-free; keep modules independent (declare `dependencies`).
- Keep docs and `llms.txt` in sync (`npm run llms`).
- Keep the `.ac-powered` credit in the base template and starters (users may remove it; MIT).

## Don't
- Don't add runtime dependencies, CDNs, or build steps required by consumers.
- Don't hard-code colours, `left/right`, `px` font sizes, or `!important` (except documented utilities).
- Don't edit files in `dist/` by hand; don't commit `node_modules/`.
- Don't remove or rename public `AC.*` APIs, `data-ac` names, or `--ac-*` tokens without a CHANGELOG entry.

License: MIT © 2026 Ali Asghar Ramin. Powered by AIR — https://air.co.ir/

# AraminConsole skill

AraminConsole = **one CSS + one ES module** (`dist/`). No npm install, no framework. Components start from `data-ac="name"` attributes (also on HTML injected later) and expose `window.AC`. Repo: https://github.com/ARaminco/AraminConsole · demo: https://araminco.github.io/AraminConsole/demo/ · full docs: `llms-full.txt`.

Install this skill: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/aramin-console/` (all projects) or `<project>/.claude/skills/aramin-console/`.

## 1. Setup (any stack)
```bash
cp -r AraminConsole/dist ./public/aramin     # or download dist/ from the repo
```
```html
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl" data-ac-icons="/aramin/icons.svg">   <!-- lang="en" dir="ltr" for English -->
<head>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
  <script src="/aramin/aramin-console-boot.js"></script>      <!-- classic script, in <head>, before CSS -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/aramin/aramin-console.min.css">
  <script type="module" src="/aramin/aramin-console.min.js"></script>
</head>
```
Ready projects: `starters/html`, `starters/laravel-blade`, `starters/nextjs` (copy the closest one first). Keep `fonts/` next to the CSS.

## 2. Rules
- Reuse classes (`.ac-card`, `.ac-btn`, `.ac-bento`, `.ac-stat`, `.ac-table`, …); never invent colours: use `var(--ac-*)`.
- Logical CSS only (`margin-inline-start`, never `left/right`); flip directional icons with `.ac-flip-rtl`; no inline `style=""`.
- Static text: Persian in markup + `data-i18n="area.key"` and dictionaries via `AC.i18n.configure({ url: '/i18n/{lang}.json' })`.
- Icons are a Lucide sprite: `<svg class="ac-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-house"/></svg>`. Only icons listed in `src/icons/icons.txt` exist; for others rebuild with the name added.
- Events are `ac:<component>:<event>` (bubble). Options: `data-*` or `data-ac-config='{json}'`. Instance: `AC.instance(el, 'name')`.
- Keep the small `.ac-powered` credit («قدرت گرفته از ایر», https://air.co.ir/) in base layouts unless the user asks to remove it.

## 3. Layout building blocks
| Need | Markup |
|---|---|
| App shell | `.ac-shell > header.ac-appbar[data-ac=appbar] + aside.ac-rail[data-ac=rail] + .ac-scrim + .ac-main > main.ac-content#ac-content + nav.ac-tabbar[data-ac=tabbar]` + `.ac-toasts#ac-toasts` |
| Page | `section.ac-page > header.ac-page-head[data-ac=largetitle] (.ac-page-head__titles > __eyebrow/__title/__sub, __actions)` then `.ac-bento.ac-stagger` |
| Grid | `.ac-bento` 12 cols; children `ac-span-xs-6` (phone half), `ac-span-md-{3,4,6,8,12}`, `ac-span-{2..9,12}` (desktop) |
| Card | `.ac-card > __head(__titles > __title/__sub, __actions) + __body(--flush) + __foot` |
| KPI | `.ac-kpis > .ac-kpi` or `.ac-stat(__label/__value/__foot)` with `data-ac="counter" data-to="1200" data-decimals data-prefix data-suffix` |
| Utilities | `ac-stack ac-cluster ac-row ac-spread ac-grid ac-gap-N ac-hide-mobile ac-hide-desktop ac-hide-phone ac-ltr ac-num ac-text-muted` |
| Tones | `data-tone="accent|success|warning|danger|info|neutral"`; badges `.ac-badge--success` etc. |

## 4. Component cheat-sheet (`data-ac` names)
| Name | Key options / markup | Events / API |
|---|---|---|
| `form` | `<form class="ac-form" data-ac="form">`, field rules `data-ac-rules="required|email|iran-mobile|iran-national-id|min:3"` | `ac:form:submit {formData, waitUntil(promise)}`, `ac:form:invalid` |
| `input` | `data-clear`, `data-counter` | |
| `password` | `data-strength`, `data-checklist` | |
| `otp` | `data-length=6`, `data-name`, `data-mask` | `ac:otp:complete {value}` |
| `number`, `range` | `data-bubble`, `data-prefix/suffix` | |
| `rating`, `swatches` | `data-max`, `data-value`; `data-colors` | `ac:rating:change`, `ac:swatches:change` |
| `combobox` | `data-multiple`, `data-loader`, `data-min-chars` | `ac:combobox:change` |
| `tags` | `data-name`, `data-max` | `ac:tags:change` |
| `datepicker`, `timepicker` | `data-calendar=persian|gregory|islamic`, `data-range`, `data-name`, `data-min/max`, `data-calendars` | `ac:datepicker:change`, `ac:timepicker:change` |
| `dropzone` | `data-max-files`, `data-max-size`, `data-uploader` | `ac:dropzone:add/done/remove` |
| `wizard` | stepper + panes | `ac:wizard:change` |
| `modal` | `.ac-modal[data-ac=modal][data-size=sm|md|lg|full]`; phone = bottom sheet | `AC.modal.open('#id')`, `ac:modal:open/close` |
| `sheet`, `drawer` | bottom sheet with snaps / side drawer | `AC.sheet.open`, `AC.drawer.open('#id')` |
| `dropdown`, `popover` | `data-placement` | `ac:menu:select` |
| `tabs`, `segmented`, `navpill` | ARIA tablist / radio group | `ac:tabs:change`, `ac:segmented:change {value}` |
| `accordion` | `data-single` | `ac:accordion:toggle` |
| `table` | `<div data-ac="table" data-ac-config='{"pageSize":10}'><table>…` ; `th data-type=number|date data-filter=select data-sortable=false`, `td data-value` | `ac:table:sort/select/bulk/action` |
| `list` | rows with swipe actions | `ac:list:action` |
| `tree`, `kanban`, `split` | hierarchical, drag board, resizable panes | `ac:tree:select`, `ac:kanban:move` |
| `chart` | `data-ac-config='{"type":"line|area|bar|donut|gauge|sparkline|heatmap","labels":["a","b"],"series":[{"name":"X","data":[1,2]}]}'` | `AC.chart(el, cfg)` |
| `code`, `json`, `logview` | `data-lang`, `data-lines`; JSON `data-ac-config='{"data":{}}'` | `ac:code:copy` |
| `ring` | `data-value`, `data-max`, `data-tone` | |
| `counter` | `data-to data-decimals data-duration data-compact data-currency` | |
| `alert` | dismissible `.ac-alert` | `ac:alert:close` |
| `money`, `money-unit` | `data-currency=IRT|IRR|USD`, `data-currencies`, `data-words` | `ac:money:change` |
| `bank-card`, `card-form`, `sheba` | `data-number data-holder data-expiry`; bank detected from number/Sheba | `ac:bank-card:bank`, `ac:sheba:change` |
| `map`, `location-picker` | `data-center="35.7,51.4" data-zoom data-controls`; picker `data-name` | `ac:map:ready`, `ac:location-picker:change` |
| `files` | file manager, adapter-based (module `files`) | `ac:files:open/select/upload` |
| `invoice-ir` | `data-ac-config='{"type":"proforma","data":{…}}'` (module `invoice-ir`) | `ac:invoice-ir:change` |
| `chat`, `mail`, `terminal`, `uptime`, `sla` | respective modules | `ac:chat:send`, `ac:mail:open` |
| `notifications`, `langpicker`, `rail`, `dock`, `tabbar`, `pull-refresh`, `largetitle`, `appbar` | shell behaviours | `ac:pull-refresh:refresh {waitUntil}` |
| `prose`, `completeness`, `privacy`, `notify-prefs`, `install-card` | content, profile, PWA | |

## 5. Runtime API (`window.AC` / ES exports)
`AC.toast(opts|text)` · `AC.toast.success|error|warning|info(title)` · `AC.toast.promise(p,{loading,success,error})` · `await AC.confirm({title,text,tone})` → boolean · `await AC.prompt({...})` · `AC.modal.open|close(sel)` · `AC.theme.set({theme,accent,density,radius})` / `.toggle()` · `AC.i18n.set('fa'|'en'|'ar')`, `AC.t(key, fallback, vars)`, `AC.i18n.setDigits('native')` · `AC.format.number|date|relative` (`calendar:'persian'`) · `AC.palette.add([{id,title,href|run}])` · `AC.rail.open|close` · `AC.use('maps')` lazy module · `AC.scan(root)` start components in new DOM · `AC.copyText(t)` · `AC.validate`.

## 6. Theming
`<html data-theme="light|dark" data-accent="orange|violet|blue|emerald|rose|amber|slate" data-density="comfortable|compact" data-radius="sharp|default|round">`. Override tokens in `:root`: `--ac-accent`, `--ac-ink`, `--ac-bg`, `--ac-surface-1/2/3`, `--ac-border`, `--ac-text`, `--ac-muted`, `--ac-r-xl`, `--ac-control-h`, `--ac-font`. Details: `reference/theming-and-modules.md`.

## 7. Recipes (full markup in `reference/recipes.md`)
Dashboard (KPI counters + chart bento) · CRUD table page (table + modal form + toast + confirm delete) · Form with Iranian validation (mobile, national id, Jalali date, Sheba, money) · Official invoice · Map with picker · File manager · Login/OTP page. Read the recipe before writing the page.

## 8. Pitfalls
- `fetch()`-loaded fragments need an http server, not `file://`.
- Don't put `<script>` in injected fragments; wire behaviour with delegated listeners or `AC.instance`.
- Next.js/React: load the module client-side once; call `AC.scan(container)` after route changes (see `starters/nextjs`).
- Rebuilding a custom bundle: `node scripts/build.mjs --modules=forms,table,chart --out=public/aramin`.
- Verify visually at 390px width and in dark mode before finishing.

More: `reference/components.md` (class names per area), `reference/recipes.md`, `reference/theming-and-modules.md`.

<!-- ===== docs/CONVENTIONS.md ===== -->

# AraminConsole — Conventions (Phase 2 builders read this first)

`docs/SPEC.md` is the contract; this is how the foundation implements it. Follow it exactly.

## 1. Workflow
- `npm run build` (or `node scripts/build.mjs --watch`) → `dist/`. `npm run serve` → http://localhost:5178/demo/
- Check: `node tests/shots.mjs <page> [--full]` (390×844 + 1440×900, light/dark, fa/en → `tests/screens/`, prints console errors + horizontal overflow). `node tests/shell.mjs`, `node tests/pwa.mjs`.
- The demo SW is **off on localhost** (stale caches). Enable with `localStorage['ac:sw']='1'`.
- Budget: CSS < 120 KB min for the WHOLE framework; the foundation already uses ~80 KB. Keep each new component file lean (aim ≤ 6 KB min), no comment banners per rule, reuse tokens/utilities.

## 2. File ownership
| Owner | Files |
|---|---|
| Foundation (do not edit — ask) | `tokens.css`, `base.css`, `layout.css`, `components/{button,nav,card,misc,palette}.css`, `src/js/core.js`, `components/{rail,tabbar,largetitle,tabs,palette,press,pull-refresh,ring}.js`, `index.js`, `scripts/*`, `demo/index.html`, `demo/app.js` |
| Data-table engineer | `components/table.css` (base styles exist — extend), `table.js` |
| Others | one new CSS file per family: `form.css`, `overlay.css`, `feedback.css`, `data-display.css`, `chart.css`, `kanban.css`, `calendar.css`, `chat.css`; one JS module per component |
| Pages | `demo/pages/<name>.html` (+ optional `<name>.js`), `demo/auth/*.html`, `demo/errors/*.html` |

Shared files you may append to (add, never reorder/remove): `src/icons/icons.txt`, `demo/i18n/{fa,en,ar}.json`, `src/js/index.js` (one `import './components/x.js'` line + optional `export { x } from …`).
The build concatenates `components/*.css` alphabetically — never rely on another component file's order.

## 3. Registering a component
```js
// src/js/components/sheet.js
import { AC, register, on, emit, options, trapFocus, scrollLock, gesture, instance } from '../core.js';
register('sheet', (el) => {                  // runs for every [data-ac~="sheet"], now and when injected later
  const o = options(el, { snap: 0.5 });       // data-* attrs + data-ac-config='{json}'
  const off = on(el, 'click', '[data-close]', () => close());
  function close() { emit(el, 'sheet:close'); }   // → CustomEvent "ac:sheet:close", bubbles
  instance(el, 'sheet', { close });            // AC.instance(el,'sheet').close()
  return () => off();                          // destroy: called when el leaves the DOM
});
export const sheet = { open(sel) { /* imperative API */ } };
AC.sheet = sheet;
```
Bundler limits (scripts/build.mjs): only `import {a, b as c} from './x.js'`, `import './x.js'`, `export function|const|let|class`, `export {…}`, `export {…} from`, `export * from`. No default exports, no circular imports, no npm imports.
Multiple components on one element: `data-ac="tabs counter"`.

## 4. Core JS API (`window.AC`, also ES exports)
- DOM: `$`, `$$`, `on(target, type, [selector], fn)` → off(), `h(tag, attrs, ...children)`, `emit(el, 'name:event', detail)`, `uid()`, `escapeHtml`, `icon(name, cls)` → svg string, `options(el, defaults)`.
- Overlays: `trapFocus(container, {initial, returnFocus})` → release(); `scrollLock.lock()/unlock()` (ref-counted, sets `html[data-scroll-locked]`); `focusables(el)`.
- Gestures: `gesture(el, { axis:'x'|'y'|'both', threshold:8, filter(e), onStart(s), onMove(s), onEnd(s) })` → destroy. `s = {dx, dy, vx, vy (px/ms), axis, pointerType, target, cancelled}`. Axis-locked: a vertical move on an `axis:'x'` gesture is released to the browser. Set CSS `touch-action: pan-y` (horizontal swipe) / `pan-x` / `none` (kanban drag). The click after a real drag is swallowed. Drive visuals with CSS vars: `el.style.setProperty('--ac-drag', dx+'px')`.
- State: `store.get/set/remove` (JSON, localStorage). Keys: `ac:theme ac:accent ac:density ac:radius ac:lang ac:rail ac:digits`.
- `theme.get()` → `{theme:'auto|light|dark', resolved, accent, density, radius}`; `theme.set({...})`; `theme.toggle()`; event `ac:theme:change`.
- `i18n.set('en')` (async), `i18n.t(key, fallback, vars)` = `AC.t`, `i18n.extend(lang, dict)`, `i18n.lang/dir/locale`, event `ac:i18n:change` on document — re-render any JS-generated text on it.
- Formatting: `format.number(n, {decimals, compact, currency:'USD', percent})`, `format.date(d, {dateStyle, calendar:'persian'|'gregory'})`, `format.relative(d)`. Latin digits by default (`i18n.setDigits('native')` for Persian digits).
- Misc: `reducedMotion()`, `isRTL()`, `isMobile()` (<1024px), `haptic()`, `rafThrottle(fn)`, `debounce(fn)`, `ready(fn)`, `rail.open/close/toggle/collapse`, `palette.add([{id,title,i18n?,hint?,group?,icon?,keywords?,shortcut?,href?,run?}])/open/close`.
- Declarative helpers: `data-ac="counter"` (`data-to data-decimals data-prefix data-suffix data-compact data-currency`), `data-ac="ring"` (`data-value data-max data-tone`), `data-ac="tabs"`, `data-ac="segmented"`, `data-ac="largetitle"`, `data-ac="pull-refresh"`, `[data-ac-palette-open]`, `[data-ac-rail-open|-close|-toggle]`, `[data-ripple]`.
- Events are always `ac:<component>:<event>` (`ac:tabs:change`, `ac:segmented:change {value}`, `ac:pull-refresh:refresh {waitUntil(promise)}`).

## 5. Tokens cheat-sheet (`--ac-*`, never hard-code colours)
- Surfaces: `bg bg-subtle surface-1 surface-2 surface-3 elevated hover active scrim` · lines `border border-strong` · text `text text-soft muted faint`
- Ink (black primary; white in dark): `ink ink-hover ink-contrast` · chrome `chrome-bg pill-bg pill-bg-hover shadow-chrome` · `lift` (hover translate) · `pill-h flyout-w`
- Accent (orange `#f0532d` default, use sparingly): `accent accent-2 accent-hover accent-soft accent-soft-2 accent-ink`(readable accent text) `accent-contrast`(text on solid accent) `ring focus gradient aurora`
- Status: `success|warning|danger|info` + `-soft` + `-ink`; `neutral-soft neutral-ink`; charts `chart-1..8 chart-grid`
- Glass: `glass-bg glass-bg-strong glass-border glass-blur` · shadows `shadow-xs sm md lg xl glow inset`
- Radius `r-xs sm md lg xl 2xl pill` · space `s-0..12` (0.25rem steps) · type `fs-2xs xs sm md lg xl 2xl 3xl 4xl`, `lh-tight snug normal`, `fw-*`
- Metrics (density-aware): `control-h control-h-sm control-h-lg control-px card-pad row-h gap touch`
- Motion: `ease ease-out ease-in ease-spring dur-1..4 press` · z: `z-sticky rail appbar tabbar dropdown drawer sheet modal toast palette tooltip`
- Layout: `appbar-h tabbar-h rail-w rail-w-collapsed content-max content-pad safe-top/bottom/start/end`
- Tones: any component colouring itself from `--_tone` gets `data-tone="accent|success|warning|danger|info|neutral"` for free.
- Private per-component vars start with `--_` (e.g. `--_bg`). Dark mode = token swap only: if you need `:root[data-theme="dark"] .x`, you are probably missing a token.

## 6. Class naming
`.ac-block`, `.ac-block__element`, `.ac-block--modifier`; state via ARIA/data attributes (`[aria-selected="true"]`, `[aria-expanded]`, `[aria-current="page"]`, `[data-state="open|closed"]`, `[aria-busy="true"]`, `[disabled]`). Logical properties only (`inset-inline-start`, `margin-inline-end`, `padding-block`); physical `left` only for JS-measured indicators/charts. Directional icons get `.ac-flip-rtl`. No inline `style=""` in markup.
Existing atoms to reuse: `.ac-btn(--primary|secondary|outline|accent|soft|ghost|danger|danger-soft|link|gradient|sm|lg|icon|square|block)` (all pills; primary = ink), `.ac-searchpill`, `.ac-kpis > .ac-kpi(--accent)(__head|__label|__value|__foot)`, `.ac-inset(__head)`, `.ac-label`, `.ac-figure`, `.ac-flag[data-flag=us|eu|ae|ir|gb|tr]`, `.ac-legend--inline`, `.ac-btn-group`, `.ac-card(__head|__titles|__title|__sub|__actions|__body|__body--flush|__foot)(--flat|inset|glass|interactive|aurora|accent|pad)`, `.ac-stat(__head|__icon|__label|__value|__unit|__foot|__spark)`, `.ac-trend[data-trend=up|down|flat]`, `.ac-badge(--accent|success|warning|danger|info|neutral|solid|outline|dot|lg)`, `.ac-count`, `.ac-chip(+__remove, aria-pressed)`, `.ac-status[data-status]`, `.ac-avatar(--xs|sm|lg|xl|square|gradient)[data-color=1..8]`, `.ac-avatar-group`, `.ac-kbd`, `.ac-divider(--label|--vertical)`, `.ac-skeleton(--text|title|circle|block|w-25|w-50|w-75)`, `progress.ac-progress(--success|warning|danger|sm|lg)`, `.ac-ring`, `.ac-empty(__art|__title|__text|__actions)`, `.ac-list(__item|__thumb|__main|__title|__meta|__end)(--divided|--inset)`, `.ac-feed(__item|__icon|__body)`, `.ac-tabs(--pills)`, `.ac-segmented(--block|--sm)`, `.ac-breadcrumbs`, `.ac-pagination`, `.ac-stepper(--vertical)>.ac-step[data-state]`, `.ac-table(--stack)`, `.ac-chart-slot(--sm|--lg|--square)`, `.ac-legend`, `.ac-hero`, `.ac-tile`, `.ac-section(__head|__title|__sub)`.
Utilities: `.ac-stack .ac-cluster .ac-row .ac-spread .ac-grow .ac-grid .ac-grid-2/3/4 .ac-gap-0..8 .ac-truncate .ac-clamp-2 .ac-visually-hidden .ac-hide-mobile(<1024) .ac-hide-desktop .ac-hide-phone(<640) .ac-num .ac-mono .ac-ltr .ac-text-(xs|sm|lg|soft|muted|accent|success|warning|danger|start|center|end) .ac-stagger .ac-animate-in .ac-pressable .ac-only-light .ac-only-dark`.
Bento: `.ac-bento` (12 cols) + children `.ac-span-xs-6` (phone half), `.ac-span-md-{3,4,6,8,12}` (≥640), `.ac-span-{2..9,12}` / `.ac-row-2` (≥1024), `.ac-span-xl-{3,4,6,8}` (≥1280). Default = full width. Don't combine `ac-span-12` with another lg span.

## 7. Page fragment shape (`demo/pages/<name>.html`)
```html
<section class="ac-page" data-page="users" [data-script]>
  <header class="ac-page-head" data-ac="largetitle">
    <div class="ac-page-head__titles">
      <span class="ac-page-head__eyebrow">…</span>
      <h1 class="ac-page-head__title" data-i18n="nav.users">کاربران</h1>
      <p class="ac-page-head__sub">…</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ac-page-head__actions">…buttons…</div>
  </header>
  <div class="ac-bento ac-stagger"> … cards … </div>
</section>
```
No `<script>` tags inside fragments. With `data-script`, the router imports `demo/pages/<name>.js`: `export default function mount(root, AC) { …; return () => cleanup }`. Mock data → `demo/data.js`. Every rail link `#/<name>` maps to `pages/<name>.html`; missing pages show "coming soon" (and a 404 in the console — so ship every page). Auth/error pages are standalone HTML documents: copy the `<head>` of `demo/offline.html` (boot script + CSS) and use `.ac-auth` / `.ac-fullpage`.

## 8. Icons
Add the Lucide name to `src/icons/icons.txt` (check `node_modules/lucide-static/icons/<name>.svg` exists; the build warns otherwise), rebuild, use `<svg class="ac-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-name"/></svg>` (sizes `.ac-icon--sm|md|lg|xl`). In JS: `AC.icon('name')`. Custom icon: drop `src/icons/<name>.svg` and list it.

## 9. i18n
Static text: Persian in markup + `data-i18n="area.key"`; attributes: `data-i18n-attr="placeholder:area.key; aria-label:area.key2"`. Add the key to **all three** `demo/i18n/*.json` (keep alphabetical). Prefix keys by area: `nav.* group.* app.* common.* status.* col.*` (shared) and `<page>.*` (page-local: `users.*`, `kanban.*`). JS text: `AC.t('key', 'fallback')` and re-render on `ac:i18n:change`. Injected HTML is translated automatically.

## 10. Mobile patterns (must use)
- Shell: <1024px rail → drawer, bottom tab bar, large titles. Content already pads for the tab bar + safe areas. Fixed elements near the bottom: `calc(var(--ac-tabbar-h) + var(--ac-safe-bottom) + …)` on mobile.
- Modal on phone = bottom sheet (`overlay.css`): same markup, `@media (max-width: 639.98px)` restyles it with a grab handle and drag-to-dismiss via `AC.gesture(el, {axis:'y'})`.
- Tables → cards: `.ac-table--stack` + `<td data-label="…" data-i18n-attr="data-label:col.x">`; the data table may render a real card list instead.
- Swipe actions on rows: `gesture(row, {axis:'x'})` + `touch-action: pan-y`, reveal actions underneath, snap by velocity (`|vx| > 0.5`).
- Touch targets ≥ 44px (`--ac-touch`); no hover-only affordances; `:active` press = `transform: var(--ac-press)`.
- Every animation ≤ 320 ms with `var(--ac-ease)`; reduced motion is globally handled — but guard JS animations with `AC.reducedMotion()`.

## 11. Shell v2 — floating pills (docs/DESIGN.md)
Light warm-gray canvas, white hairline cards (`--ac-r-xl` 22px, no shadow, hover lift inside `.ac-bento`; opt out `.ac-card--static`), black primary pills, orange accent only for: one filled KPI (`.ac-kpi--accent` / `.ac-card--accent`), switches, ranges, progress, chart highlight (`chart-1` = ink, `chart-2` = accent), brand mark, FAB.
- **Top bar** `header.ac-appbar[data-ac=appbar]` → `.ac-appbar__inner` = start (`a.ac-chrome.ac-brand` > `.ac-brand__mark` + `.ac-brand__name`) · center (`#ac-appbar-title.ac-appbar__title` phone-only collapsing title + `nav.ac-chrome.ac-topnav[data-ac=navpill]` > `.ac-topnav__link`, the router sets `aria-current`, a sliding ink pill follows) · end (`.ac-chrome.ac-utilbar` > `.ac-iconbtn` buttons, `.ac-appbar__count`; `a.ac-chrome.ac-userchip`). `.ac-chrome` = any white floating pill; `[data-hide-phone]`, `[data-mobile-only]` inside the bar.
- **Dock** `aside.ac-dock[data-ac=dock]` (≥1024px, fixed, start edge): `.ac-dock__pill` groups of `.ac-dock__btn` — theme pill `[data-theme-set=light|dark]` (aria-pressed synced), section buttons `[data-ac-rail-group="<id>"]` (open the flyout; the group holding the current page gets `[data-active]` = ink circle), links (`aria-current`), `.ac-dock__foot` (help / sign out), `.ac-dock__dot`. Tooltips come from `aria-label`.
- **Rail** `aside.ac-rail#ac-rail[data-ac=rail]`: groups `div.ac-rail__group[data-group="<id>"]` (+ `.ac-rail__label`, `.ac-rail__link`, `details.ac-rail__sub`). Desktop = flyout next to the dock showing one group; phone/tablet = floating drawer with all groups. `.ac-rail__head` (`.ac-rail__heading-text`, `.ac-rail__close`), `.ac-rail__search`, `.ac-rail__foot` (drawer only). API `AC.rail.open(group?) / close() / toggle(group?)`; triggers `[data-ac-rail-group] [data-ac-rail-open] [data-ac-rail-toggle] [data-ac-rail-close]`. `collapse()` is kept but no longer changes the layout.
- **Tab bar** `.ac-tabbar` (<1024px) is a floating pill, icons only (labels stay for screen readers), sliding ink circle, center `.ac-tabbar__fab` orange.
- **Page head**: greeting-style `.ac-page-head__title` (semibold), muted `__sub`, primary action = `.ac-btn--primary` (black pill).
- Defaults: `theme: light`, `accent: orange` (`theme.accents` starts with `orange`).

<!-- ===== docs/DESIGN.md ===== -->

# AraminConsole — Visual Direction (binding, supersedes SPEC §2 visuals)

The owner rejected the first look (dark rail, violet accent). The target is the reference reel
"Dashboard V14 — Modern & Minimal UI" (code.xr, product name "Vertix"). Frames: `docs/reference/ref-overview.png`, `ref-manage.png`.
Match its feel closely, then make it RTL-first and app-like on phones.

## What the reference looks like
- **Canvas:** very light warm-gray page (`~#f3f3f4`), content sits in one big rounded white "app frame" feel; cards are **pure white, radius ~20–24px, hairline border (`~#ececee`) and almost no shadow**. Lots of air; 16–20px gaps.
- **Top bar = three floating white pills** on the canvas:
  1. brand pill (logo mark in a filled orange-red circle + product name),
  2. **centered segmented nav** inside a white pill: Overview · Activity · Manage · Program · Account · Reports — the active item is a **solid black pill with white text** that slides (animated) between items,
  3. utilities pill: search, bell, clock/history icon buttons + user chip (avatar, name, email, chevron).
- **Side rail = slim floating vertical white pill** (≈48px wide) at the start edge, icon-only: theme toggle (sun/moon) on top in its own small pill, then section icons (active = black filled circle with white icon), and at the bottom a separate small pill with help/logout. Not a wide dark sidebar.
- **Page head:** big greeting / title in dark ink ("Good morning, Code XR" — ours: «صبح بخیر، علی») with a one-line muted subtitle; primary action at the end as a **black pill button** ("+ New card").
- **Accent:** orange-red `#f0532d`-ish (gradient `#ff6a3d → #ee4a22`) used sparingly: the one highlighted KPI tile (filled orange gradient card with white text), toggles/switches ON state, sliders/progress fill, chart highlight bars, brand mark. Everything else is black/gray/white. Positive deltas in small green pill (`+5%`), negatives in small red pill.
- **Buttons:** primary = black pill (`#111`), white text, icon + label; secondary = light gray pill (`#f2f2f3`) dark text; small chip-style filters (Search field pill, "Filter ▾" pill).
- **KPI cards:** small label with an icon circle at the end, big number (counting-up animation), small delta pill + "This month" muted. One card filled orange.
- **Charts:** rounded bars, black + orange series, light gray grid, tiny labels; legend as dots.
- **Tables:** inside white card, header row on very light gray rounded strip, small text, status as dot + label, search pill + filter pill in the card header.
- **Credit card / object visuals:** dark glossy card with subtle pattern; controls list with labeled toggles (title + muted description) separated by hairlines.
- **Typography:** clean geometric sans (Latin: Inter-like system stack; Persian/Arabic: Vazirmatn), headings semi-bold not heavy, numbers tabular, small muted labels (11–12px).
- **Motion (framer-motion style):** cards lift `translateY(-4px)` with softer shadow on hover, staggered fade-up entrance of cards on page load, nav pill slides, numbers count up, bars grow from baseline, toggles spring.
- **Dark mode:** same structure, canvas `#0b0b0c`, cards `#161618`, hairline `#232326`, active pill becomes **white with black text**, accent stays orange.

## Translating to our framework
- Desktop (≥1024px): floating slim rail + top pills layout above. Top segmented nav shows the main sections of the current workspace (Dashboard, Analytics, Users, Orders, Console, Reports…) with an overflow "More ▾" pill; the slim rail holds app-level destinations/groups (icons with tooltips) and opens a **flyout panel** for groups with many pages.
- Tablet (640–1023): top pills collapse: brand + utilities; nav pill scrolls horizontally; rail hidden → bottom tab bar.
- Phone (<640): app-like: large greeting title that collapses into a compact top bar on scroll; **bottom tab bar is a floating white pill** (not full-width bar) with the active tab as black circle/pill and a center orange FAB; sheets, swipe, pull-to-refresh as before.
- RTL: rail on the right, everything mirrored via logical properties.
- Accent presets remain (orange default + others), but the **default theme is light with orange accent and black primary**.

<!-- ===== docs/SPEC.md ===== -->

# AraminConsole — Build Contract (v0.1)

This is the single source of truth every builder follows. If something is not here, choose the option that keeps the framework zero-dependency, RTL-first, accessible and app-like on phones.

## 1. What it is
An open-source (MIT) **admin panel UI/UX framework**: a CSS design system + a small vanilla-JS runtime of components + a complete demo app that shows every screen an admin panel or ops console needs. No framework, no runtime dependencies, no build step required to *use* it (one CSS file + one ES module). Works inside plain HTML, Node servers, Laravel Blade, Next.js, anything.

Consumers: the owner's panels (Gisoo, AStack console, NetArz, CoHub, Laravel/Filament admin replacements) and the public.

## 2. Design direction
- **Feel:** premium, calm, modern SaaS (Linear / Vercel / Apple-level polish), not a Bootstrap template. Soft depth (layered shadows), glass chrome (backdrop-filter blur on app bar / tab bar / sheets), generous radii (12–20px), subtle aurora gradient accent in hero areas, crisp 1px borders, tabular numbers.
- **Motion:** every interaction has motion, all of it short (120–320ms) with spring-like easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`; respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (all motion off). Page transitions via View Transitions API with fallback fade/slide. Press feedback: `scale(.97)` on buttons/cards/tabs. Animated tab indicator, animated number counters on stat tiles, chart draw-in, skeleton shimmer, staggered list entrance.
- **Mobile = native app:** below 1024px the side rail disappears and a **bottom tab bar** (5 slots, glass, animated pill indicator, center FAB optional) appears; iOS-style **large title** collapses into the app bar on scroll; **bottom sheets** with drag handle and drag-to-dismiss; **swipe actions** on list rows; **pull-to-refresh**; safe-area insets (`env(safe-area-inset-*)`); 44px minimum touch targets; no hover-only affordances; tables turn into cards; modals become sheets. Installable PWA (manifest + service worker + offline page), `theme-color` follows theme.
- **Font:** Vazirmatn variable (`src/fonts/vazirmatn-variable.woff2`, OFL) for all scripts; Latin digits in data tables unless the locale switch selects Persian digits.
- **Icons:** Lucide (ISC), from `node_modules/lucide-static/icons/<name>.svg`. The build script assembles a sprite `dist/icons.svg` containing ONLY the icons listed in `src/icons/icons.txt` (one name per line). Usage: `<svg class="ac-icon"><use href="#i-<name>"/></svg>` — the runtime injects the sprite inline at boot (`AC.icons.load()`), so `href="#i-house"` works. Builders: add every icon you use to `icons.txt`.
- **Themes:** `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>` (auto from `prefers-color-scheme` when unset), accent presets via `data-accent="violet|blue|emerald|rose|amber|slate"` (default violet `#6d4aff`), density `data-density="comfortable|compact"`, radius `data-radius="sharp|default|round"`. Theme customizer drawer in the demo.
- **Direction & language:** `dir="rtl"` default (fa), `dir="ltr"` (en), Arabic (ar, rtl). Use CSS **logical properties only** (`margin-inline-start`, `inset-inline-end`, `padding-block`, `border-start-start-radius`…) — never `left/right` except for physical things like chart axes. Directional icons (chevrons, arrows) flip with `.ac-flip-rtl`.

## 3. Naming
- CSS: prefix `ac-`. BEM-ish: `.ac-card`, `.ac-card__head`, `.ac-card--flat`. State via attributes/ARIA (`[aria-selected=true]`, `[data-state=open]`, `[disabled]`), not `.is-*` classes where ARIA exists.
- Tokens: CSS custom properties `--ac-*` defined in `src/css/tokens.css`. Components use ONLY tokens for color, radius, shadow, spacing, motion. Dark mode must work purely by token swap.
- JS: global namespace `window.AC` and ES module exports from `dist/aramin-console.js`. Declarative first: components auto-initialise from `data-ac="<component>"` attributes (`data-ac="tabs"`, `data-ac="table"`, `data-ac="sheet-trigger"`…) via a MutationObserver, so injected HTML just works. Each component also has an imperative API (`AC.toast({...})`, `AC.modal.open('#id')`, `AC.sheet.open(...)`, `AC.confirm({...})` → Promise<boolean>, `AC.palette.open()`, `AC.theme.set({...})`, `AC.i18n.set('en')`).
- Events: `CustomEvent`s named `ac:<component>:<event>` bubbling from the element (`ac:tabs:change`, `ac:table:select`, `ac:sheet:close`).

## 4. Required token groups (`src/css/tokens.css`)
Color (bg, surface 1–3, elevated, border, border-strong, text, text-soft, muted, accent + accent-soft + accent-ink + ring, success/warning/danger/info each with soft + ink, chart-1..8), glass (chrome bg + blur), shadows (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, glow), radius (xs..2xl, pill), space scale (0.25rem steps `--ac-s-1..12`), type scale (`--ac-fs-xs..4xl` + line heights), z-index layers (rail, appbar, tabbar, dropdown, sheet, modal, toast, palette), motion (`--ac-ease`, `--ac-ease-out`, `--ac-dur-1..4`), layout (`--ac-appbar-h`, `--ac-tabbar-h`, `--ac-rail-w`, `--ac-rail-w-collapsed`, `--ac-content-max`).

## 5. File layout
```
src/css/tokens.css          tokens + themes + accents + density
src/css/base.css            reset, typography, font-face, focus ring, scrollbars, selection, utilities (stack, cluster, grid, text, visually-hidden)
src/css/layout.css          app shell: rail (collapsible, groups, badges), app bar, content, large title, bottom tab bar, FAB, page header, responsive grid, auth layout
src/css/components/*.css    one file per component family (button, form, card, table, overlay, nav, feedback, data-display, chart, kanban, calendar, chat, misc)
src/js/core.js              AC namespace, auto-init registry, events, dom helpers, focus trap, scroll lock, storage, gestures (drag/swipe)
src/js/components/*.js      one module per component; each exports `init(el)` and registers itself
src/js/index.js             entry: imports everything, boots, exposes window.AC
src/icons/icons.txt         icon names used
scripts/build.mjs           concat CSS → dist/aramin-console.css (+ .min), bundle JS modules → dist/aramin-console.js (simple concat of ES modules into one module is fine; or copy src/js to dist/js and make dist/aramin-console.js re-export), sprite → dist/icons.svg, copy fonts → dist/fonts
scripts/serve.mjs           zero-dep static server on http://localhost:5178 serving repo root, SPA fallback for /demo/
demo/index.html             the demo app shell (SPA)
demo/app.js                 demo router + mock data wiring
demo/data.js                realistic mock data (Persian + English names, Jalali dates, IRR/AED/USD amounts)
demo/pages/<page>.html      one HTML fragment per screen, loaded by the router into the shell
demo/manifest.webmanifest, demo/sw.js, demo/offline.html
docs/                       component docs (markdown) — one file per component family
tests/                      Playwright (playwright-core, system chromium at %LOCALAPPDATA%/ms-playwright) smoke + screenshot tests
```

## 6. Component inventory (all required for v0.1)
**Shell & navigation:** side rail (collapsible to icons, nested groups, badges, workspace switcher, user card), app bar (search trigger, notifications bell with count, theme toggle, language switch, user menu), breadcrumbs, bottom tab bar + FAB, large collapsing title, page header with actions, tabs (underline + pills), segmented control, pagination, stepper, command palette (Ctrl/⌘+K, fuzzy search over pages and actions, recent, keyboard nav), quick search.
**Inputs:** button (primary, secondary, ghost, soft, danger, link; sizes; icon-only; loading; group), input/textarea with prefix/suffix/clear/counter, floating label variant, select, combobox (searchable, async), multi-select with chips, tag input, checkbox, radio, switch, slider/range, rating, OTP/PIN input, number stepper, password (show/strength), color swatch picker, **date picker with Jalali (Persian) AND Gregorian calendars** (uses `Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian')`, no deps), date range, time picker, file dropzone with previews & progress, form layout, inline validation (`data-ac-rules="required|email|min:3|iran-mobile|iran-national-id"`), wizard form.
**Overlays:** modal/dialog (sizes, fullscreen-on-mobile → sheet), drawer (side), bottom sheet (snap points, drag), dropdown menu, context menu (right click / long press), popover, tooltip, confirm dialog (Promise), toast (stack, actions, undo, progress, swipe-to-dismiss), alert/banner, notification center panel.
**Data display:** card variants (stat tile with trend + sparkline + animated counter, bento grid), **data table** (sort, global search, column filters, pagination, page size, row selection + bulk action bar, column visibility, sticky header, row expansion, inline row actions, CSV export, empty/loading states, responsive → card list on mobile with swipe actions), list (with avatars, meta, swipe actions), description list, badges/chips/status dots, avatars + group, progress (bar, ring), skeletons, empty states with illustration (inline SVG), timeline/activity feed, accordion, tree view, code block with copy, key/value JSON viewer, diff/log viewer.
**Charts (inline SVG, no deps):** line, area (gradient), bar (grouped/stacked), donut/pie, radial gauge, sparkline, heatmap (contributions-style), with tooltips, legend, responsive resize, RTL-aware axes, draw-in animation. API: `AC.chart(el, {type, series, labels, ...})` and `data-ac="chart" data-ac-config='{...}'`.
**Apps / screens in the demo (each a page fragment):**
1. `dashboard` — KPI bento, revenue area chart, orders bar chart, traffic donut, recent orders table, activity feed, top products, goals ring.
2. `analytics` — date-range filters, multi charts, heatmap, funnel.
3. `users` — full data table with filters, bulk actions, user drawer/sheet, create user modal form.
4. `user-profile` — cover, tabs (overview, activity, security, sessions).
5. `roles` — roles & permissions matrix with toggles.
6. `orders` + `invoice` — order list, printable invoice page (`@media print`).
7. `products` — grid/list toggle, filters, product editor form with images.
8. `kanban` — drag & drop board (pointer events, works with touch), add card.
9. `calendar` — month/week views, Jalali + Gregorian toggle, events.
10. `chat` — conversations list + thread, bubbles, attachments, typing indicator; mobile = two screens with push transition.
11. `mail` — inbox three-pane, mobile stacked.
12. `files` — file manager grid/list, upload dropzone, breadcrumbs, context menu.
13. `notifications` — notification center page.
14. `console` — **ops console**: live log stream viewer (filter by level, pause, follow), server/service status cards, uptime bars, terminal-style command box, jobs/queue table, incidents timeline.
15. `monitoring` — CPU/RAM/disk gauges, realtime-updating sparkline charts.
16. `settings` — sectioned settings (general, appearance with theme customizer, notifications, security, API keys with copy/regenerate, billing), mobile = iOS-style grouped list.
17. `forms` — showcase of every input + validation + wizard.
18. `components` — living style guide: every component with variants.
19. `pricing`, `faq` (accordion), `timeline`.
20. Auth (standalone pages, no shell): `login`, `register`, `forgot`, `otp`, `lock` — split layout desktop, full-screen app-like mobile.
21. Errors: `404`, `500`, `maintenance`, `offline`.

## 7. Demo app behaviour
- Hash router (`#/dashboard`), page fragments fetched from `demo/pages/`, injected into `<main>`, components auto-init, page transition animation, title + active nav updated, scroll restored. Auth/error pages are standalone `demo/auth/*.html`, `demo/errors/*.html`.
- Language switch fa/en/ar swaps `dir`, `lang`, and text via `data-i18n` keys from `demo/i18n/{fa,en,ar}.json` (shell + nav + common UI at minimum; page body content may stay Persian with English in en for main headings).
- Settings persist in `localStorage` (`ac:theme`, `ac:accent`, `ac:lang`, `ac:rail`).

## 8. Quality bar
- Lighthouse-grade a11y: semantic HTML, labelled controls, focus visible, focus trap in overlays, Esc closes, roving tabindex in menus/tabs, `aria-*` correct, contrast AA in both themes.
- No inline `style=""` in markup (CSP friendly); JS may set CSS variables via `el.style.setProperty`.
- No console errors on any page at 390×844 (phone), 820×1180 (tablet), 1440×900 (desktop), in fa/rtl and en/ltr, light and dark.
- No horizontal overflow on phone on any page.
- Performance: CSS < 120KB min, JS < 120KB min (unminified source size may be larger).

<!-- ===== docs/data.md ===== -->

# Data display — tables, charts, lists, logs

Files: `src/js/components/{table,chart,list,accordion,tree,code,logview}.js`, `src/css/components/{table,chart,data}.css`.
Demo: `#/users`, `#/analytics`, `#/dashboard`. Mock data: `demo/data.js` (named exports `users orders products servers logs makeLog dailyVisits activity trafficFor topPages referrers rng daysAgo`).
Tests: `node tests/data.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178`.

Strings shown to the user go through `AC.t()` (keys `table.* chart.* log.* json.* common.copy|copied`) and re-render on `ac:i18n:change`. Numbers use `AC.format` (Latin digits unless `AC.i18n.setDigits('native')`).

## Charts — `AC.chart(el, cfg)` (stable API)

```html
<div class="ac-chart-slot" data-ac="chart" data-ac-config='{"type":"bar","labels":"days:7","series":[{"name":"dash.online","data":[120,152,138]}]}'></div>
```
```js
const c = AC.chart('#rev', { type: 'area', labels: 'months:12', series: [{ name: 'Income', data: [...] }] });
c.update({ series })   // or c.update(seriesArray) — redraw with new data/options (keeps hidden-legend state)
c.push([v1, v2], 'label')   // realtime: append one point per series, keep the last `window` points
c.set(cfg)             // replace config (resets legend state) · c.redraw() · c.destroy() · c.config
AC.instance(el, 'chart')   // the same API for declarative charts
```
The element should have a height (`.ac-chart-slot`, `--sm|--lg|--square`, `.ac-stat__spark`); otherwise `height` (px, default 240) is applied. `heatmap` and `funnel` size themselves.

| option | meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | `line` `area` `bar` `sparkline` `donut` `pie` `gauge` `heatmap` `funnel` |
| `series` | `[{ name, data:[…], color?, dashed? }]` or `[[…]]`; donut/pie/funnel: `[n, n, …]` |
| `labels` | array (ISO dates are formatted with `labelFormat`, Jalali in fa) or generator `"months:12"`, `"days:7"`, `"dates:30"` |
| `name`, `labels`, `title`, `centerLabel`, `label`, `unit` | plain text **or an i18n key** (`"dash.income"`) — translated and re-rendered on language change |
| `color` / series `color` | `1..8` (`--ac-chart-N`), `accent success warning danger info neutral contrast` |
| `stacked`, `horizontal` | bar variants; `values:false` hides horizontal value labels |
| `format`, `prefix`, `suffix` | passed to `AC.format.number` (e.g. `{"currency":"USD"}`), text around values |
| `smooth` (true), `zero`, `yMin`, `yMax`, `axis` (true), `legend` (auto), `gap`, `radius`, `window` | |
| gauge | `value`, `min`, `max`, `thresholds:[warn, danger]` |
| heatmap | `data:[{date, value}]`, `end`, `weeks` (53), `weekStart` (Sat in fa/ar), `levels:[a,b,c]` |
| `animate:false` | no draw-in (also off with reduced motion) |

Look (DESIGN.md): series 1 = `--ac-chart-1` (ink), series 2 = `--ac-chart-2` (orange accent); rounded bar tops; bars grow from the baseline when scrolled into view; dot legends (click toggles a series, `ac:chart:toggle`); light grid; tooltip with crosshair on hover/touch; arrow keys/Home/End inspect points when the plot is focused. RTL mirrors the x axis (time flows right→left). Theme and language changes redraw. Every chart gets `role="figure"`, an `aria-label` and a visually-hidden data table.

## Data table — `data-ac="table"` / `AC.table(el, cfg)`

Progressive enhancement: `<div data-ac="table" data-ac-config='{"pageSize":5}'><table>…</table></div>` reads the header/body cells (`<th data-type="number|date" data-filter="select" data-primary data-sortable="false">`, `<td data-value="…">` for sort values) and keeps the cell HTML.

```js
const t = AC.table(el, {
  id: 'users',                 // persists hidden columns / page size / density in localStorage
  rows, rowId: 'id', pageSize: 10, pageSizes: [10, 25, 50, 100], sort: { key: 'joined', dir: 'desc' },
  selectable: true, bulkActions: [{ id: 'delete', label, i18n, icon, tone: 'danger' }],
  actions: [{ id: 'edit', label, i18n, icon: 'pencil', tone, when: (row) => bool }],
  expand: (row) => '<dl class="ac-dl">…</dl>',
  columns: [{ key, label, i18n, type, primary, sortable, filter: 'text'|'select', options, hidden, hideable,
              align: 'end', mobile: false, value(r), text(r), render(r), sortValue(r), csv: false|fn,
              /* type extras */ currency, decimals, compact, dateOptions, badges: { v: { tone, label, i18n } }, sub, image, initials, color }],
  search: true, toolbar: true, columnsMenu: true, density: true, exportable: true, pagination: true, info: true,
  cards: true /* phone card list */, maxHeight: 480 /* sticky header inside a scroll box */, loading: false, caption, exportName, tools: '<button…>',
});
```
Cell types: `badge` (dot + label), `avatar` (avatar + name + `sub`), `money`, `number`, `date` (Jalali in fa), `progress`, `html` (from markup).
API: `setRows setColumns setLoading search filter sort page select clearSelection selected toCSV exportCSV refresh destroy`, getters `rows view state`.
Events (bubble from the element): `ac:table:sort {sort}` `search {query}` `filter {filters}` `page {page}` `select {ids, rows}` `expand {id, open}` `action {action, id, row}` `bulk {action, ids, rows}` `export {csv, name}` (preventDefault to handle the file yourself).
Behaviour: click header = sort, Shift+click = multi-sort (numbered); `aria-sort` on headers; the bulk bar is sticky under the app bar on desktop and a floating glass pill above the tab bar on phones; CSV is UTF-8 with BOM (Persian opens correctly in Excel) and exports the selection if any; below 640px rows render as cards (primary column + status + 2-column key/value grid) with swipe-to-reveal actions; loading skeleton and empty state with "clear filters". Row action menus use inline icon buttons; pages may put an overlay `menu` in `tools`/`render` instead.

## Lists and swipe — `data-ac="list"`, `AC.swipeable(item)`
```html
<ul class="ac-list" data-ac="list" role="list"><li class="ac-list__item ac-swipe">
  <div class="ac-swipe__actions"><button class="ac-swipe__btn" data-action="archive" data-tone="info"><svg…/>Archive</button></div>
  <div class="ac-swipe__content">…avatar · .ac-list__main · .ac-list__end…</div></li></ul>
```
Swipe toward the inline start reveals actions (mirrored in RTL), flick velocity > 0.5 snaps, one row open at a time, Esc closes. Events `ac:swipe:open`, `ac:swipe:action {action, item}`, `ac:list:action`.

## Description list, timeline
`<dl class="ac-dl [ac-dl--cols-2]"><div><dt/><dd/></div></dl>` · `<ol class="ac-timeline"><li class="ac-timeline__item" data-tone="success"><time/><div class="ac-timeline__body"><strong/><p/></div></li></ol>` (the existing `.ac-feed` is the activity feed).

## Accordion — `data-ac="accordion" [data-single]`
`<details class="ac-accordion__item"><summary class="ac-accordion__head">Q</summary><div class="ac-accordion__body">A</div></details>`; animated height (Web Animations, off with reduced motion); `ac:accordion:toggle`; `AC.instance(el,'accordion').toggle(i, open?)`.

## Tree — `data-ac="tree"` / `AC.tree(el, { items:[{ id, label, icon, meta, open, children }] })`
ARIA tree, roving tabindex; ↑ ↓ Home End, → expand/first child, ← collapse/parent (mirrored in RTL), Enter/Space select, type-ahead. Events `ac:tree:select {id, item}`, `ac:tree:toggle`. API `setItems expandAll selected`.

## Code block and JSON viewer
`<div data-ac="code" data-lang="js|json|bash|php…" [data-lines] [data-title]><pre><code>…</code></pre></div>` — copy button (`ac:code:copy`), light highlighting, always LTR.
`<div data-ac="json" data-ac-config='{"data":{…},"open":2}'></div>` or `AC.json(el, data, { open })` — collapsible nodes with counts, expand-all and copy. `AC.copyText(text)` → Promise<boolean>.

## Log viewer — `data-ac="logview"` / `AC.logview(el, cfg)`
```js
const log = AC.logview(el, { lines, max: 5000, render: 500, levels: ['debug','info','warn','error'], timestamps: true });
log.push({ ts, level, src, msg }); log.push('plain text line'); log.pause(true); log.follow(); log.filter({ levels: ['error'], q: 'timeout' }); log.clear();
```
Level chips with live counts (Alt+click = only this level), search with highlight, timestamps toggle, pause/resume (new lines are counted while paused), follow-tail with a "N new / Latest" jump pill when scrolled up, DOM capped to `render` lines (buffer keeps `max`). Event `ac:logview:pause {paused}`.

## Testing
- `node tests/data.mjs` — demo pages (users, analytics, dashboard): table, charts, log viewer, overflow and console errors.
- `node tests/data-fixture.mjs` — standalone fixture `tests/fixtures/data.html` (no shell): multi-sort, CSV of a selection (UTF-8 BOM), phone swipe → `ac:table:action`, chart keyboard and `push()`, log pause/search, tree keys (RTL-aware), accordion, JSON, code.
- Both take `--base=http://localhost:<port>`; open the fixture in a browser to see every data-display component at once.

<!-- ===== docs/files.md ===== -->

# Files — file, document and records manager

A Finder / File Explorer-class manager as a module: `src/modules/files/` (`files.js`, `files.css`, `files-icons.js`,
`files-adapter.js`, `files-preview.js`, `module.json`). Demo: `demo/#/files` (sample content in `demo/content/files/`,
regenerated by `node tests/make-files-content.mjs`). Tests: `node tests/files.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178`;
screenshots: `node tests/files-shots.mjs`.

```js
await AC.use('files');                       // or the full bundle / import { install } from 'src/modules/files/files.js'
const fm = AC.files('#files', {
  adapter,                                   // storage adapter (below); default: an empty in-memory adapter
  id: 'docs',                                // persists view, sort, group, icon size, column widths, panes (ac:files:<id>)
  view: 'icons',                             // icons | list | columns | gallery  (phones: list | icons | gallery)
  start: 'root',                             // first location (phones default to the Browse screen '@browse')
  favorites: ['contracts', 'finance'],       // folder ids pinned in the sidebar
  calendar: 'auto',                          // auto (Jalali in fa) | persian | gregory
  iconSize: 76,                              // 48–128, also the status-bar slider
  docTypes: ['قرارداد اجاره', 'فاکتور'],     // suggestions for the "Document type" field
});
fm.go('@starred'); fm.open(id); fm.select([ids]); fm.setView('list'); fm.quickLook(id); fm.info(true);
fm.upload(fileList, folderId); fm.rename(id); fm.trash(ids); fm.refresh(); fm.selection; fm.state; fm.destroy();
```
Declarative: `<div data-ac="files"></div>` (empty in-memory adapter). The element gets `.ac-fm`; give it a height with
`--fm-h` (desktop/tablet). On phones it flows with the page (window scroll, sticky large title).

## Storage adapter
Every method is async (returns a Promise) and returns plain objects. Only `list` and `stat` are required; missing
methods hide the matching UI. `AC.files.memoryAdapter(seed, opts)` is the reference implementation.

| Method | Returns | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `info()` | `{ root, name }` | id of the root folder |
| `list(id)` | `Entry[]` | a folder's children, or a virtual list: `@recent`, `@starred`, `@shared`, `@trash`, `@tag:<tagId>` |
| `stat(id)` | `Entry` | must include `path: [{ id, name }]` from the root (breadcrumbs, Get Info "Where") |
| `read(id, { peek })` | `{ kind, url?, text?, poster? }` | `kind`: `image pdf video audio text office none`. `peek: true` must not touch "last opened" (thumbnails) |
| `thumbnail(entry, size)` | `url \| null` | optional server rendition (PDF first page, Office render, video poster). `null` → the UI renders one |
| `upload(folder, file, { onProgress(loaded, total), signal, isPaused(), conflict, name, url })` | `Entry` | `conflict`: `replace` (new version) \| `keep` (unique name). Honour `signal` (cancel); `isPaused` only if `capabilities.pause` |
| `exists(folder, name)` | `id \| null` | used for conflict detection (falls back to `list`) |
| `mkdir(folder, name)` | `Entry` | |
| `rename(id, name)` | `Entry` | throw `{ code: 'EXIST' }` on a clash, `{ code: 'EINVAL' }` for bad names |
| `move(ids, folder)` · `copy(ids, folder, { suffix })` | `Entry[]` | refuse moving a folder into itself |
| `compress(ids, folder, name)` | `Entry` | |
| `trash(ids)` · `restore(ids)` · `remove(ids)` · `emptyTrash()` | `true` | `remove` is permanent |
| `search(query, { scope, kind, date, size, tag })` | `Entry[]` | `scope` = folder id or null (everywhere); `kind`: `folder document pdf image video audio xls zip`; `date`: `today week month year`; `size`: `small medium large` |
| `share(id, { expires (days, 0 = never), password, permission })` | `{ url, expires, password, permission }` | |
| `versions(id)` · `restoreVersion(id, versionId)` | `[{ id, date, size, by, current? }]` · `Entry` | |
| `activity(id)` | `[{ action, at, by }]` | actions: upload create rename move copy trash restore share edit replace compress restoreVersion sign review view |
| `update(id, patch)` | `Entry` | `starred tags comment doc status ocr shared color` |
| `tag(ids, tagId, on)` | `true` | bulk tagging |
| `tags()` · `users()` · `locations()` · `freeSpace()` | | sidebar tags `{ id, name, color, count }`, people `{ id, name, email, color }`, storage `{ id, name, icon, used, total, root? }` |

`capabilities: { pause, versions, share, tags, trash, search, upload, comments }`. Names of tags, users and locations
may be `{ fa, en, ar }`.

**Entry**: `{ id, name, kind: 'file'|'folder', type, parent, size, created, modified, opened, path, count (folders),
tags: [tagId], starred, shared: [{ user, role: 'owner'|'editor'|'commenter'|'viewer' }], comment, url, thumb, duration (s),
dims: [w, h], glyph (folder emblem: docs money id lock scan code media images archive shared download), color (folder tint),
doc: { type, number, date, parties, expiry, remind }, status: 'draft'|'review'|'approved'|'signed', ocr: 'done'|'pending'|'' }`.
`type` is derived from the extension when absent (`typeOf(name)`: folder pdf doc xls ppt image video audio zip code txt unknown).

A REST adapter is a thin mapping — see `demo/content/files/files-adapter.js` for a sketch.

## Content previews (real thumbnails)
Order: `adapter.thumbnail()` → client rendering from `adapter.read(id, { peek: true })`, cached per id + modified date,
loaded lazily by one `IntersectionObserver`:
- images — decoded and downscaled on a canvas (≤ 360 px, WebP blob URL); SVG used as is;
- video — a frame at ~1 s drawn to a canvas, play badge + duration;
- text / code / Markdown / CSV — the first lines rendered as a mini page (CSV as a small table);
- audio — a waveform from `OfflineAudioContext.decodeAudioData`;
- Office files — the server rendition when the adapter returns one, otherwise a styled first-page placeholder;
- PDF — the server rendition, or the first page through **pdf.js as an optional plugin** (never bundled; Apache-2.0):
  `AC.files.plugins.pdfjs = { src: '/vendor/pdf.min.mjs', worker: '/vendor/pdf.worker.min.mjs' }` (or `AC.files.pdfjs`).
  Without either, the PDF keeps its document artwork.

The large live preview (preview pane, column view preview column, gallery stage, Quick Look) shows the full image, a video /
audio player, CSV as a table, Markdown rendered (`AC.markdown` from the `prose` module when loaded, else a built-in safe
renderer), plain text / code in monospace, and PDFs in the browser's own viewer (`<object>`, pages scroll) with a
first-page fallback where the browser has none.

## Interface
- **Toolbar**: sidebar toggle, back / forward (mirrored in RTL), breadcrumb (click a segment; click empty space,
  double-click or Ctrl+L for the editable path field), view switcher, sort & group menu, share, preview pane, Get Info,
  more menu, search (scope: this folder / everywhere; filter chips kind, date, size, tag), new folder, Upload.
- **Sidebar**: Favorites (All Files, Recents, Starred, Shared, pinned folders), Locations with usage bars, Tags (coloured
  dots, counts), Trash. Every entry is a drop target (drop on a tag = tag it, on Trash = trash it).
- **Views**: icons (custom artwork per type, live thumbnails, Persian-aware middle truncation that keeps the extension,
  icon-size slider), list (sortable + resizable columns name / date modified (Jalali in fa) / size / kind / tags / status,
  disclosure triangles that expand folders inline), columns (Miller columns + preview column), gallery (large preview +
  filmstrip). Group by kind / date / tags. Status bar: count, selection size, free space.
- **Records**: approval chip (draft / under review / approved / signed), OCR badge (+ "Run OCR" placeholder), expiry badge
  (≤ 45 days warning, expired danger) with a reminder switch; record fields (type, number, date, parties, expiry) in Get Info.
- **Get Info** (side panel ≥ 1100 px container, drawer on tablets, sheet on phones): preview, kind, size (bytes), where,
  created / modified in Jalali + Gregorian, dimensions / duration, record, tags editor, comments, sharing & permissions
  (role per person), version history with restore, activity.
- **Share dialog**: link, expiry, password switch, permission; people with access.
- **Uploads**: floating card at the bottom inline-end: per-file progress rings, pause / resume, cancel, retry, done / error
  states, overall bar, collapse; name clashes ask Replace / Keep Both / Skip (+ apply to all). Drop files from the desktop
  anywhere (onto a folder to upload into it).

## Keyboard & pointer
| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| arrows (spatial in icons; RTL aware), Home / End, type-ahead | move; Shift extends |
| Enter, Ctrl+↓ | open · Space = Quick Look (Space / Esc closes, ← → page, + / − zoom) |
| Backspace, Alt+←, Ctrl+[ · Alt+→, Ctrl+] · Ctrl+↑ | back · forward · enclosing folder |
| F2 · Delete · Ctrl+A · Ctrl+C / X / V · Ctrl+D · Ctrl+I · Ctrl+Shift+N · Ctrl+F · Ctrl+L · Ctrl+1…4 | rename · trash (undo toast) · select all · clipboard · duplicate · info · new folder · search · path · views |
| list view → / ← (mirrored) | expand / collapse a folder |
Click, Ctrl/⌘-click, Shift-click, rubber-band marquee on empty space (Ctrl adds), double-click opens. Drag items onto
folders, breadcrumbs, sidebar entries, tags or Trash (Alt/Ctrl = copy); hovering a folder for 0.8 s springs it open.
Right-click (or long-press on tablets) opens the context menu: Open, Quick Look, Get Info, Rename, Duplicate, Compress,
Move to ▸, Copy, Cut, Copy Link, Share…, Tags ▸, Star, Move to Trash (Trash: Put Back / Delete Immediately).

## Phones and tablets
Phones (< 640 px) get a native Files-app layout: Browse screen (favorites, locations, tags as inset grouped lists), list-first
folders with a large title, back button with the previous location, a search bar that collapses on scroll, rows with
date · size · tags and record chips, swipe a row to Star / Trash, long-press to enter selection mode (checkboxes, title
"n selected", Select All / Done) with a selection bar replacing the tab bar, menus as action sheets, Quick Look full-screen
with swipe between files and swipe-down to close. Inputs are ≥ 16 px. Tablets: two panes (sidebar + view), Get Info as a drawer.

## Motion
Items stagger in on folder change; opening a folder zooms from it (back zooms out); sorting and view switches FLIP the
artwork to its new place (spring easing from `AC.motion` when present); selection highlights spring; the drag ghost lifts,
tilts and shows a count badge; Quick Look zooms from the thumbnail. With reduced motion the module keeps the fades and
drops the travel.

## Events
`ac:files:navigate {loc, entry}` · `ac:files:select {ids}` · `ac:files:open {entry}` (cancelable — default opens Quick Look) ·
`ac:files:change {action, ids}` (trash restore delete emptytrash move copy duplicate compress rename mkdir star tag) ·
`ac:files:upload {entry}`.

## i18n
Built-in fa / en / ar strings; any `fm.<key>` in the app dictionary overrides them (keys: see `S` at the top of `files.js`).

<!-- ===== docs/finance.md ===== -->

# Iranian finance kit — money, calendars, banks, bank card

Files: `src/js/components/{money,date,bank,bank-card}.js` (+ calendar engine in `datepicker.js`), `src/css/components/finance.css`, `src/banks/` (metadata, logos, `SOURCES.md`). Module: `money` (+ `datepicker` for `AC.date`).
Build output: `dist/banks.svg` (logo sprite, lazy-loaded on first use, ≈410 KB / 66 KB gzip), `dist/banks.json`, `dist/LICENSE-bank-logos.txt`.
Demo: `#/finance` (and `#/manage`). Test: `node tests/finance.mjs [--base=http://localhost:5178]`.

> **Trademarks.** Bank and card-network logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are included for identification only. Sources and licences per logo: `src/banks/SOURCES.md`.

## Bidi rules (RTL pages)
Card numbers, Sheba/IBAN and amounts are always isolated LTR inside RTL text: live amounts render `<bdi dir="ltr">number</bdi> unit` inside an element whose `dir` follows the language, so a minus sign stays next to the digits («‎-4,275,000 تومان»). The bank card itself is laid out LTR (like a physical card); Iranian cards put the logo, holder and expiry on the right.

## Money — `AC.money`
Currencies: `IRR` (ریال), `IRT` (تومان = 10 ریال; not an ISO code), `USD EUR AED GBP TRY CNY`, and `GOLD` (گرم طلا ۱۸) / `COIN` (سکه).
```js
AC.money.format(12500000, { currency: 'IRT' })                         // "12,500,000 تومان" (fa) · "12,500,000 Toman" (en)
AC.money.format(125e6, { from: 'IRR', currency: 'IRT', compact: true }) // "12.5 میلیون تومان"
AC.money.format(3e9, { currency: 'IRR', compact: true })               // "3 میلیارد ریال"  · ≥ 10¹² Toman → "2.5 همت"
AC.money.format(1250, { currency: 'USD', lang: 'en' })                 // "$1,250"   · { digits: 'native' } → "۱۲٬۵۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان"
AC.money.parts(-4275000, { currency: 'IRT' })                          // { num: '-4,275,000', unit: 'تومان', pre: false, dir: 'rtl', text }
AC.money.toWords(1200000)                                              // "یک میلیون و دویست هزار"  · { lang: 'en' } → "one million two hundred thousand"
AC.money.words(12.5, { currency: 'USD' })                              // "دوازده دلار و پنجاه سنت"
AC.money.convert(1000, 'IRT', 'IRR')                                   // 10000 — other pairs need AC.money.setRates({ USD: 1050000, … }) (rials per unit)
AC.money.parse('۱۲٬۵۰۰٫۵')                                            // 12500.5
AC.money.setUnit('IRR')                                                // page-wide display unit, persisted in ac:money-unit; event ac:money:unit
```
Options for `format`/`parts`: `currency`, `from` (stored currency, converted), `compact`, `display: auto|symbol|name|code|none`, `decimals`, `digits: latn|native`, `lang`, `sign`.
Persian/Arabic put the unit name after the number; English puts `$ € £ ¥ ₺` before and `IRR`/`AED` as a code prefix.

### Live amounts and the Rial/Toman switch
```html
<span data-ac-money="48250000000" data-currency="IRR" data-compact data-words></span>   <!-- follows the page unit -->
<span data-ac-money="1200000" data-currency="IRT" data-to="USD"></span>                 <!-- fixed target currency -->
<div data-ac="money-unit"></div>                                                        <!-- segmented «ریال / تومان» -->
```
Stored amounts in `IRR`/`IRT` follow `AC.money.unit`; switching re-renders every `[data-ac-money]` with a short number ticker (pop-in for compact values; off with reduced motion). `AC.money.html(amount, { currency, to, compact })` returns the same markup. Language and digit changes re-render too. `data-words` puts the amount in words in `title`.

### Money input — `data-ac="money"`
```html
<div class="ac-field">
  <label class="ac-label" for="amt">مبلغ</label>
  <div class="ac-input-group ac-money" data-ac="money" data-name="amount" data-currency="IRT" data-currencies="IRT,IRR,USD"><input class="ac-input" id="amt"></div>
</div>
```
Live thousand separators while typing (caret stays next to the same digit), Persian/Arabic digits accepted (shown in the active digit style), decimals only for currencies that have them, a unit picker when `data-currencies` lists more than one (switching Toman↔Rial converts the amount), and the amount in words under the field (`data-words="false"` to hide). Hidden inputs: `amount` (raw number) and `amount_currency`. Event `ac:money:change {value, currency, text, words}`; API `.value .currency .set(v, currency?) .clear()`.

### Tables and stat tiles
`AC.table` columns with `type: 'money'` and `currency: 'IRR'|'IRT'` (or `GOLD`/`COIN`) format through `AC.money` and follow the Rial/Toman switch; other ISO currencies keep `AC.format.number`. In KPI tiles put `<span data-ac-money=… data-compact>` in `.ac-kpi__value`.

## Dates — `AC.date` and the date picker
Calendars: `persian` (Jalali/Shamsi, default for fa), `gregory`, `islamic` (Hijri lunar, Umm al-Qura via `Intl`). Month and weekday names come from `Intl` in the active language; weeks start on Saturday for fa/ar.
```js
AC.date.format('2026-10-20', { calendar: 'persian', style: 'numeric', digits: 'native' }) // "۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۲۸"
AC.date.format('2026-10-20', { style: 'long' })     // "سه‌شنبه ۲۸ مهر ۱۴۰۵"  (styles: numeric short medium long month relative)
AC.date.format(d, { style: 'relative' })            // "۳ روز پیش"
AC.date.parts('2024-03-11', 'islamic')              // { y: 1445, m: 9, d: 1 }
AC.date.toDate(1405, 7, 28, 'persian')              // Date (UTC midnight) · AC.date.toISO(…) · AC.date.today()
AC.date.convert({ y: 1403, m: 1, d: 1 }, 'persian', 'gregory') // { y: 2024, m: 3, d: 20 }
AC.date.holidays(1405)                              // [{ iso, name, en, kind: 'solar'|'lunar' }]
AC.date.holiday('2026-03-21')                       // { name: 'جشن نوروز', … } · AC.date.isHoliday(d) (holiday or Friday)
AC.date.adjustHijri({ '1447-1': 1 })                // shift a Hijri month to Iran's announced date
```
ISO strings (`YYYY-MM-DD`) are taken literally; `Date` objects use their local Y/M/D.

**Holidays.** Solar holidays (Nowruz 1–4 Farvardin, 12 and 13 Farvardin, 14–15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand) are fixed Jalali dates, checked against the official 1404–1406 calendars. Lunar holidays (Tasua, Ashura, Arbaeen, 28 Safar, last day of Safar, 8 and 17 Rabi al-Awwal, 3 Jumada al-Thani, 13 and 27 Rajab, 15 Sha'ban, 21 Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr ×2, 25 Shawwal, Eid al-Adha, Ghadir) are computed from their fixed Hijri dates with Umm al-Qura. **Approximation:** Iran fixes lunar months by local moon sighting, so a lunar holiday can be one day off (e.g. Ashura 1404: Umm al-Qura 2025-07-05, official 2025-07-06). Correct known months with `AC.date.adjustHijri`. Fridays are weekend.

**Date picker additions** (`data-ac="datepicker"`): the switch now offers شمسی / میلادی / قمری (`data-calendars="persian,gregory"` limits it); `data-secondary="gregory|persian|islamic|auto"` prints the equivalent day small under each day; Fridays and official holidays are red with the holiday name as tooltip/label (default on in fa; `data-holidays="true|false"`). Hidden values remain ISO Gregorian.

## Banks — `AC.bank`
```js
AC.bank.detect('6037991234567890')     // { slug: 'melli', fa, short, en, colors: [c1, c2], accent, bins, sheba, logo, country: 'IR' }
AC.bank.network('4111…')               // shetab | visa | mastercard | amex | unionpay | mir | jcb | discover | diners | null (Iranian BINs win)
AC.bank.luhn(n) · AC.bank.formatCard(n, { sep: '-', mask }) // "6037-9912-3456-7890" · AC.bank.mask(n) → "6037-99••-••••-7890"
AC.bank.sheba.valid('IR82 0540 1026 8002 0817 9090 02') · .bank(v) → parsian · .normalize(v) · .format(v)
AC.bank.iban.valid('DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00') · .format(v) · .country(v) · .checksum('IR', bban)
AC.bank.list() · .foreign() · .networks() · .get(slug)
AC.bank.logo('melli', { mono, network, class, title })  // <svg class="ac-bank-logo"><use href="#bank-melli"/></svg>
```
Validation rules added to forms: `data-ac-rules="sheba"`, `"iban"`, `"card"` (Luhn, any network).
Logos: `<svg class="ac-bank-logo [ac-bank-logo--sm|--lg]"><use href="#bank-melli"/></svg>`; `#bank-<slug>-mono` is single-colour (`currentColor`); networks are `#net-<slug>`. The sprite is fetched once (`AC.bank.load()`, next to the bundle, or `<html data-ac-banks="url">`).
