- [Theming](theming.md): tokens, accents, dark mode, and density.
- [Forms](forms.md), [Overlays](overlays.md), [Data display](data.md): every component with its markup.
- [Conventions](CONVENTIONS.md): naming, events, and the shell structure.

<!-- ===== docs/invoice-ir.md ===== -->

# Iranian invoices — `invoice-ir` module

Files: `src/modules/invoice-ir/{invoice-ir.js,invoice-ir.css}`. Demo: `#/invoice-official`, `#/invoice-proforma`, `#/invoice-editor`. Test: `node tests/invoice-marketing.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178` (writes A4/A5 PDFs to `tests/screens/`).

Two documents from one data object:

- **Official** — «صورتحساب فروش کالا و خدمات», laid out like the tax organisation's standard form used with سامانهٔ مؤدیان: title, serial, Jalali date and «شماره منحصربه‌فرد مالیاتی»; «مشخصات فروشنده» / «مشخصات خریدار» (name, national ID / شناسه ملی, کد اقتصادی, شماره ثبت, کد پستی, phone, full address); the 11 standard columns (ردیف، کد کالا، شرح، تعداد/مقدار، واحد اندازه‌گیری، مبلغ واحد، مبلغ کل، مبلغ تخفیف، مبلغ کل پس از تخفیف، جمع مالیات و عوارض ارزش افزوده، جمع کل), totals row, amount in words, شرایط و نحوه فروش (نقدی / غیرنقدی), notes, seller and buyer stamp boxes.
- **Proforma (پیش‌فاکتور)** — brand header (logo or a generated mark), from / bill-to cards, a simpler table, totals with the amount due, bank accounts (bank logo, card number, Sheba, account no.), a QR **placeholder** (deterministic pattern, not a scannable code — render a real QR yourself and pass an image if you need one), notes, signatures and a "not an official tax invoice" line.

The module does **not** submit anything to سامانهٔ مؤدیان; it renders and prints. The unique tax ID is whatever your integration returns.

## API

```js
import { install } from 'aramin-console/src/modules/invoice-ir/invoice-ir.js'; // or the per-module bundle
install(AC);                                   // automatic when window.AC exists

const inv = AC.invoiceIR.render('#host', data, {
  type: 'official',            // 'official' | 'proforma' (default: data.type)
  unit: 'IRR',                 // display unit 'IRR' | 'IRT' (official defaults to Rial, proforma to AC.money.unit)
  digits: 'latn',              // 'latn' | 'fa'  (defaults to AC.i18n.digits)
  paper: 'a4l',                // 'a4' | 'a4l' | 'a5' | 'a5l' (official: a4l, proforma: a4)
  toolbar: true,               // Rial/Toman · ۱۲۳/123 · paper · Print/PDF
  labels: { official: '…' },   // override any label
});
inv.update(nextData); inv.set({ unit: 'IRT', paper: 'a5' }); inv.print(); inv.totals; inv.destroy();

AC.invoiceIR.totals(data)  // → { lines:[{qty, price, gross, discount, net, vat, total}], gross, discount, net, vat, shipping, total, rate }

const ed = AC.invoiceIR.editor('#form', { data, preview: inv, storageKey: 'ac:invoice-ir:draft' });
```
Declarative: `<div data-ac="invoice-ir" data-ac-config='{"type":"proforma","data":{…}}'></div>`.
Events: `ac:invoice-ir:change {opts}` (toolbar) · `ac:invoice-ir:edit {data}` (editor, after each change).

## Data shape

```js
{
  type: 'official',               // or 'proforma'
  currency: 'IRR',                // the unit amounts are stored in ('IRR' | 'IRT')
  serial: '1405-0287', date: '2026-10-20', validUntil: '2026-10-27',   // ISO; shown as Jalali
  taxId: 'A1F2C9D41B0000A3E7C2F1',
  vatRate: 10,                    // percent; per line: item.vatRate, item.vatExempt
  payment: 'cash',                // 'cash' | 'credit' | 'mixed'
  seller: { name, brand, tagline, logo, nationalId, economicCode, regNo, postalCode, phone, address },
  buyer:  { name, nationalId, economicCode, regNo, postalCode, phone, address },
  items: [{ code, title, note, qty, unit, price, discount /* amount */ , discountPercent, vatRate, vatExempt }],
  shipping: 0, shippingLabel: 'ارسال',
  bankAccounts: [{ holder, card, sheba, account, bank /* slug, optional */ }],   // proforma
  qr: 'https://pay.example/…', notes: '…', title: 'پیش‌فاکتور',
}
```
Maths: `gross = qty × price`, `net = gross − discount`, `vat = round(net × rate / 100)` **per line**, `total = Σ(net + vat) + shipping`. Toman display divides Rial by 10 (one decimal kept when needed). Inputs accept Persian/Arabic digits and separators (`AC.invoiceIR.parseNum`).

## VAT rate — keep it configurable

Iran's VAT («مالیات و عوارض ارزش افزوده») is set in law and has changed over the years: 9% (6% tax + 3% duties) for several years up to 1402, and 10% from 1403 under the budget law of that year. **I could not verify the rate for 1404/1405 at the time of writing** (no web access from the build machine), so the module defaults to `10` and every invoice can set `vatRate` (and each line `vatRate` / `vatExempt` for exempt goods and services). Check the rate with the tax organisation (intamedia.ir) or your accountant for the invoice's year before issuing.

## Print / PDF

- `inv.print()` (or the toolbar button) calls `window.print()`; "Save as PDF" in the dialog gives the PDF. Automated: Playwright `page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' })` + `page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true, printBackground: true })`.
- In print the shell, page head, toolbar, editor and floating widgets are hidden; the sheet prints 1:1 with no shadow.
- `@page { size; margin }` is written by the module for the chosen paper (A4/A5, portrait/landscape).
- `thead` repeats on every page, totals print once at the end, rows never split, and the words / terms / signatures block stays together.
- On screen the sheet is sized in mm and scaled to fit (`--aci-zoom`); it stays white paper in dark mode.

## Dependencies

Uses `AC.money.words` (amount in words), `AC.date.format` (Jalali), `AC.bank` (`detect`, `sheba.bank`, `logo`, `formatCard`, `sheba.format`) when present; falls back to a built-in Persian number-to-words, `Intl` Persian calendar and plain grouping otherwise. Labels are built in for fa / en (ar uses fa); any `invoiceIR.<key>` in the app dictionary overrides them.

<!-- ===== docs/maps.md ===== -->

# Maps

A zero-dependency slippy-map module: raster XYZ tiles in Web Mercator, markers, clustering, popups, vectors,
heatmap, GeoJSON, draw/edit/measure, geocoder search, locate-me and a location-picker form control.
Files: `src/modules/maps/{maps.js,maps.css}` (also part of the full bundle and of `dist/modules/maps.*`).
Demo: `#/maps` (`demo/pages/maps.{html,js,css}`). Test: `node tests/maps.mjs --base=http://localhost:5192 [--shots]`.

```js
const m = AC.map('#map', { center: [35.6997, 51.338], zoom: 12, tiles: 'osm', controls: ['zoom', 'locate', 'fullscreen', 'scale'] });
m.marker([35.7576, 51.41], { icon: 'store', title: 'Vanak', drop: true }).bindPopup('<b>Vanak branch</b>');
m.flyTo([25.1972, 55.2744], 13);
```
```html
<div data-ac="map" data-center="35.7,51.4" data-zoom="12" data-controls="zoom,locate,search,layers"></div>
<div data-ac="location-picker" data-name="branch"></div>   <!-- posts branch[lat], branch[lng], branch[address] -->
```

## Engine
- Tiles are `<img>`s in one layer per integer zoom; pan / zoom / pinch / fly only rewrite `transform` on a handful of
  layer elements (compositor-only). Fractional zoom is a `scale()` of the nearest level; the next level fades in on top
  and the old one is dropped when it is covered. Level switches are throttled during animations (keeps tile requests low).
- Markers, popups and handles live in one float pane (one transform while panning; positions are recomputed only when the zoom changes).
  Vectors share one SVG and the heatmap one canvas; both are re-rendered when the map settles and transformed in between.
- Input: core `gesture` for pan (inertia from release velocity), two-pointer pinch around the midpoint, wheel/trackpad zoom
  (smoothed toward a target zoom, anchored at the cursor), double-click / double-tap zoom (+Shift = out), keyboard
  (arrows pan, `+`/`-` zoom, Esc closes popups / cancels drawing). A single map click waits ~260 ms so a double tap stays a zoom.
- `flyTo` uses the van Wijk–Nuij zoom-out/pan/zoom-in curve. Reduced motion → instant `setView`.
- Offline / blocked tiles: the map keeps working on a styled grid that pans and zooms with it, plus an "unavailable" notice.
- RTL: the canvas is always LTR internally; controls sit in logical corners (`top-start`, `top-end`, …) so they mirror.
  Coordinates are always Latin digits.

## Options
| option | default | |
|---|---|---|
| `center`, `zoom`, `minZoom`, `maxZoom` | Tehran, 11, 2, 19 | `center`: `[lat, lng]`, `{lat, lng}` or `"lat,lng"` |
| `tiles` | `'osm'` | provider id, provider object, or `{ light, dark }` (switches with the theme) |
| `muted` | `false` | desaturates the tiles so black/orange markers stand out |
| `controls` | `zoom fullscreen locate scale` | + `search` (needs `geocoder`), `layers`, `coords`, `draw` |
| `geocoder`, `reverse` | `null`, `false` | `reverse: true` → click shows address + decimal/DMS coordinates + copy |
| `baseLayers` | osm, opentopomap, none | for the layer switcher: ids or `{ id, label }` |
| `interactive`, `wheel`, `keyboard`, `inertia` | `true` | |

## API
View: `setView(c, z)`, `flyTo(c, z, {duration})`, `panTo`, `panBy(dx, dy)`, `zoomIn/zoomOut/setZoom`, `fitBounds(bounds|points, {padding, maxZoom})`,
`getCenter/getZoom`, `bounds`, `latLngToPoint`, `pointToLatLng`, `setPadding({top,right,bottom,left})` (e.g. a bottom sheet),
`setTiles(spec)`, `invalidateSize()`, `toggleFullscreen()`, `locate()`, `destroy()`. Controls offset via CSS `--ac-map-pad-top|bottom|start|end`.

Layers (all return the layer; `layer.remove()`, `setVisible(bool)`, `bindPopup(html | (layer) => html)`, `on('click', fn)`):
- `marker(latlng, { kind: 'pin'|'dot'|'vehicle'|'me'|'label', icon, tone: 'ink'|'accent'|'success'|…, title, label, html, draggable, drop, data, onClick })`
  → `setLatLng`, `setHeading(deg)` (vehicles), `setTone`. Pins are black (or orange) SVG teardrops with a drop/bounce entrance.
- `cluster(points, { radius: 64, maxZoom: 17, marker(p) → marker options, popup(p) })` — grid clustering; clusters split out of / merge into
  their parent with a 300 ms transform animation; click zooms to the members. `setPoints(points)`.
- `polyline(points, { tone, weight, casing, flow, dash })` (`flow` = animated dash), `polygon(rings, …)`, `circle(center, radiusMetres, …)`.
- `heatmap([[lat, lng, weight]…], { radius })` — canvas, self-normalising, black→orange→red palette. `setPoints`.
- `geojson(object | url, { style(feature), popup(feature, layer), point(feature, latlng), onEach })` → group (Promise for a URL).
  Point features with `properties.radius` become circles.
- `group(layers)`, `addOverlay(id, label, layer, { icon })` (listed in the layer switcher), `setOverlay(id, visible)`.
- Popups: `openPopup(latlng, html|node, { offset, wide })`, `closePopup()`; auto-pan into view.

Draw / edit / measure (`controls: ['draw']` or `m.enableDraw()` → `m.draw`): tools point, line, polygon, circle, measure distance,
measure area. Line/polygon: click to add, double-click / Enter / Finish to end, click the first vertex to close, Backspace undo,
Esc cancel. Circle: centre, then edge. Clicking a drawn shape selects it: vertex handles, mid-point handles (drag to insert),
circle centre + radius handles; Delete removes it. `draw.start(mode)`, `cancel()`, `add(feature)`, `select(id)`, `remove(id)`,
`clear()`, `list`, `get(id)`, `toGeoJSON()` (circles → Point + `radius`).

Events (bubble from the map element): `ac:map:ready`, `moveend {center, zoom}`, `zoomend`, `click {latlng}`, `contextmenu`,
`marker:click {marker, data}`, `marker:dragend`, `shape:click`, `popup:open|close`, `locate {latlng, accuracy}`, `locate:error`,
`search:select {result}`, `reverse {result}`, `base:change {id}`, `overlay {id, visible}`, `draw:start|create|edit|delete|select|deselect|cancel {feature}`,
`measure {type, value, text}`. Per-frame `move` is only on the JS bus: `m.on('move', fn)`.

Static: `AC.map.providers`, `AC.map.geocoders`, `AC.map.pick(opts)` → `Promise<{lat, lng, address} | null>`,
`AC.map.utils` (`project unproject distance pathLength area bounds formatLatLng formatDistance formatArea`), classes `Marker Path Heat Cluster Group MapView`.

## Location picker
`<div data-ac="location-picker" data-name="location" [data-center="lat,lng"] [data-zoom] [data-tiles]>` renders a summary row
(address, coordinates, "Choose on map") and keeps hidden inputs `location[lat]`, `location[lng]`, `location[address]` (so `FormData` works).
The button opens `AC.map.pick()` in a modal (bottom sheet on phones): a fixed centre pin that lifts while the map moves and drops with a small
bounce, live coordinates, reverse-geocoded address, search and locate. Geocoder: `el.geocoder` or `AC.map.defaultGeocoder`.
Event `ac:location-picker:change {lat, lng, address}`; API `AC.instance(el, 'location-picker').value / set(v) / open()`.

## Tile providers and their terms (read before shipping)
| id | Use |
|---|---|
| `osm` (default) | **Demo / light use only.** OpenStreetMap's tile servers are run by volunteers on donated resources. The [Tile Usage Policy](https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/) requires visible attribution («© OpenStreetMap contributors» linked to the copyright page — our attribution control does this and must not be hidden), a valid Referer/User-Agent, honouring cache headers, and **no heavy use, bulk downloading, prefetching or offline packs**. Access can be blocked without notice. For production traffic run your own tile server (OSM data is ODbL) or use a commercial provider. Dark theme = a CSS filter on the same tiles (no second provider). |
| `opentopomap` | Topographic style, CC-BY-SA; same light-use spirit as OSM (fair use, attribution required). |
| `carto-light`, `carto-dark`, `carto-voyager` | CARTO basemaps (Positron / Dark Matter / Voyager). Attribution «© OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO». **When checked on 2026-10-20 the public URLs answered with an "API KEY REQUIRED" image**, so they need a CARTO account: register the URL your plan gives you with `AC.map.providers.register('carto-light', { url, subdomains, attribution, retina: true })` and follow CARTO's current terms (historically free only for non-commercial use under a monthly view limit; commercial use needs a CARTO licence). |
| `none` | No tiles: the styled grid only (fully offline). |

Custom / keyed providers: `AC.map.providers.register(id, { name, url, subdomains, maxZoom, retina, attribution, darkFilter, key })`.
`url` is a template (`{z} {x} {y} {s} {r} {key}`) or a function `(z, x, y, { retina }) → url | Promise<url>`; the function form lets you
fetch with an API-key **header** and return a blob URL (revoked when the tile is dropped). Never commit keys; load them from your backend/config.

### Iranian providers (hooks, no keys included)
Both are API-key services with their own terms and attribution; take the exact endpoints from their current documentation.
- **Map.ir** — raster tiles and search/reverse APIs authenticate with an `x-api-key` header, so use the function form:
  ```js
  AC.map.providers.register('mapir', { name: 'Map.ir', maxZoom: 19, attribution: '© Map.ir © OpenStreetMap contributors',
    url: async (z, x, y) => URL.createObjectURL(await (await fetch(MAPIR_TILE_URL(z, x, y), { headers: { 'x-api-key': KEY } })).blob()) });
  ```
- **Neshan** — keys are per product (map key for the web SDK/tiles, service key `Api-Key` header for search / reverse). Same pattern.
- Geocoders: wrap their search / reverse endpoints in the geocoder interface below (`live: true` only if their terms allow search-as-you-type).

## Geocoders
Interface: `{ live?: boolean, search(text, { signal, lang, near }) → Promise<[{ label, sub, lat, lng, bbox? }]>, reverse(lat, lng, { signal, lang }) → Promise<{ label, sub } | null> }`.
The search box debounces (300 ms) and aborts stale requests when `live` is true; with `live: false` it searches on Enter only.
- `AC.map.geocoders.local(items | () => items)` — offline search over your own list (`{ label, sub, lat, lng, keywords }`), nearest-item reverse. Used by the demo.
- `AC.map.geocoders.nominatim({ url, email, countrycodes, viewbox })` — OSM Nominatim. [Usage policy](https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/):
  **max 1 request/second** (the adapter enforces it), identify your app (`email`), show attribution, cache results, and **no client-side autocomplete**
  — hence `live: false`. Heavy use → host Nominatim yourself (`url`) or use a commercial geocoder.

## Mobile
Touch targets ≥ 40 px (handles have a 40 px invisible hit area), `touch-action: none` only on the map canvas, pull-to-refresh is kept out of map drags,
16 px search input (no iOS zoom), hover styles gated by `(hover: hover)`. The demo page shows the native-maps pattern: full-screen map under the
floating app bar, a draggable bottom sheet (3 snap points, velocity aware) and `setPadding({ bottom })` so fly-to targets land above the sheet.

## Icons
`map map-pin map-pinned map-pin-plus locate-fixed maximize minimize layers plus minus search x spline pentagon circle-dot ruler square-dashed
undo-2 trash-2 check copy pencil truck wifi-off` (listed in `src/icons/icons.txt`).

<!-- ===== docs/marketing.md ===== -->

# Marketing dashboards — `marketing` module

Files: `src/modules/marketing/{marketing.js,marketing.css}`. Demo: `#/search-console`, `#/marketing` (mock data: `gscData`, `mkData`, `mkRealtime` in `demo/data.js`). Test: `node tests/invoice-marketing.mjs`.

Both dashboards take a `load()` function, so the demo's mock generators can be swapped for real API calls without touching the UI. Charts and tables use the core `AC.chart` / `AC.table` (sortable, searchable, CSV, phone cards); the Search Console chart is the module's own multi-axis SVG (each metric keeps its own scale, average position is drawn inverted like Google's).

## Search Console report

```js
const gsc = AC.marketing.searchConsole('#host', {
  range: '28d',                                   // '7d' | '28d' | '3m' | '16m' (compare is off for 16m, as in GSC)
  load: async (range, compare) => fetchGsc(range, compare),
});
gsc.reload(); gsc.exportCSV(); gsc.state; gsc.destroy();
```
UI: four toggle cards (Total clicks = accent, impressions = ink, CTR = green, position = blue; one line always stays on), chart with crosshair tooltip and ←/→ keys, tabs Queries · Pages · Countries · Devices · Search appearance · Dates (meter bar per row, deltas when comparing), index coverage (indexed vs not indexed, weekly stacked bars, reasons with source and trend), Core Web Vitals (good / needs improvement / poor stacked bars + LCP / INP / CLS chips for mobile and desktop), sitemaps, links.
Events: `ac:marketing:range {range, compare}`, `ac:marketing:metric {key, on}`.

`load()` returns:
```js
{
  dates: ['2026-09-23', …],                                // one per day
  series: { clicks: [], impressions: [], ctr: [/* % */], position: [] },
  previous: { dates, series } | null,                     // when compare
  totals: { clicks, impressions, ctr, position }, prevTotals: {…} | null,
  tabs: { queries|pages|countries|devices|appearance: [{ key, clicks, impressions, ctr, position, prev?: {…} }] },
  coverage: { indexed, notIndexed, history: [{ date, indexed, notIndexed }], reasons: [{ reason, source: 'google'|'website', pages, trend: 'up'|'down'|'flat' }] },
  cwv: { mobile|desktop: { good, ni, poor, metrics: { lcp: [2.6, 'ni'], inp: [180, 'good'], cls: [0.08, 'good'] } } },
  sitemaps: [{ url, type: 'index'|'sitemap'|'news', submitted, lastRead, status: 'success'|'warning'|'error', discovered }],
  links: { external, internal, topLinked: [[path, n]], topSites: [[host, n]], topAnchors: [[text, n]] },
}
```
Wiring to Google (server side, OAuth scope `webmasters.readonly`):
- `series`: `searchanalytics.query` with `dimensions: ['date']` for the range (and the previous range when comparing); `ctr` × 100.
- `tabs.*`: the same call with `dimensions: ['query']`, `['page']`, `['country']` (ISO alpha-3 in the API — map to alpha-2), `['device']` (`MOBILE` → `mobile`…), `['searchAppearance']`; `rowLimit` 25–1000.
- `sitemaps`: `sitemaps.list`. `coverage`, `cwv` and `links` are not in the Search Console API: use URL Inspection API samples / your own crawl, the CrUX API (`queryRecord`, p75 values) and your link data respectively, or hide those cards.

## Marketing overview (GA4-like)

```js
const ov = AC.marketing.overview('#host', {
  range: '28d',                                    // '7d' | '28d' | '3m'
  load: async (range) => fetchOverview(range),
  realtime: { load: async () => fetchRealtime(), interval: 5000 },   // paused while the tab is hidden
});
```
`load()` returns:
```js
{
  dates: [], series: { users: [], newUsers: [], sessions: [], conversions: [] },
  kpis: { users: [value, deltaPct], sessions, engagementRate, avgEngagement /* seconds */, conversions, revenue /* Rial */ },
  channels: [{ key: 'organic'|'direct'|'paidSearch'|'organicSocial'|'paidSocial'|'referral'|'email'|'display', users, sessions, engagementRate, conversions, revenue }],
  campaigns: [{ id, name, platform: 'google'|'meta', type, spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, revenue }],   // CTR, CPC, ROAS are derived
  funnel: { labels: ['visit','search','profile','slot','booked'], values: [] },
  landing: [{ id, path, sessions, engagementRate, conversions }],
  social: { months: [], networks: [{ key, name, color: 1..8, data: [] }] },
  email: [{ id, name, sent, open, ctr, unsub, date }],
}
// realtime.load() → { active, perMinute: [30 numbers], countries: [{ code, fa, en, users }], pages: [{ path, users }] }
```
Wiring: GA4 Data API `runReport` (`metrics: activeUsers, newUsers, sessions, engagementRate, userEngagementDuration, conversions|keyEvents, totalRevenue`; `dimensions: date`, `sessionDefaultChannelGroup`, `landingPage`), `runFunnelReport` for the funnel, `runRealtimeReport` (`activeUsers` by `minutesAgo`, `country`, `unifiedScreenName`) for the live card; Google Ads API (`campaign`, `metrics.cost_micros / 1e6`, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value) and Meta Marketing API insights for campaigns; social and email from their platform APIs. Money is shown with `AC.money.format` in the page unit (Rial/Toman).

## Blocks

`AC.marketing.metricChart(el, { dates, series: [{ key, name, data, color, invert, format, short, prev, on }] })` → `update redraw destroy` · `AC.marketing.realtime(el, { load, interval })` → `tick destroy` · `AC.marketing.cwv(el, data)` · `AC.marketing.meter(value, max, tone)` → HTML.
Labels are built in for fa / en (ar uses fa); any `mk.<key>` in the app dictionary overrides them. Numbers follow `AC.format` (Latin digits unless `AC.i18n.setDigits('native')`).

<!-- ===== docs/modules.md ===== -->

# Modules — include all, include some, remove one, lazy-load, write your own

AraminConsole is split into **modules**. `core` is always present; everything else is optional and can be bundled up front,
left out, or loaded on demand. The source of truth is [`src/modules.json`](../src/modules.json) plus every folder in
`src/modules/<name>/` (discovered automatically).

| Module | What it is | Depends on |
|---|---|---|
| `core` *(always)* | tokens, base, app-shell layout, motion, atoms (button, card, misc), **base form controls and tables** (static markup is always styled), runtime (`AC`, auto-init, i18n, theme, format, gestures, focus trap) and the `AC.use()` loader | — |
| `shell` | rail / dock, tab bar, large title, tabs & segmented, command palette, press ripple, pull-to-refresh, ring | core |
| `overlays` | layers & positioning, modal, sheet, drawer, menus, popover, tooltip, confirm/prompt, toast, alert, notification center | core |
| `customizer`, `langpicker` | theme customizer drawer, language picker | overlays (+ shell) |
| `forms`, `datepicker` | input behaviours, combobox, dropzone, validation, wizard; Jalali/Gregorian pickers | core / forms |
| `data-display`, `table`, `chart`, `apps`, `money` | lists, tree, code/JSON/log viewers · data table · SVG charts · kanban/split + app screens · money, banks, cards | … |
| `src/modules/*` | `pwa`, `notify`, `tickets`, `support-chat`, `chat`, `mail`, `maps`, `marketing`, `invoice-ir`, `prose`, `terminal`, `uptime`, `user-panel`, `files`, … | declared per module |

`npm run build` prints the size table (raw / min / gzip) for every module; `dist/modules/modules.json` has the resolved graph and sizes.

## Outputs
| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `dist/aramin-console.{css,js}` (+ `.min`) | **everything** — every module's CSS and JS. Static markup of any module is styled. |
| `dist/modules/<name>.{css,js}` (+ `.min`) | one module; its JS imports its dependencies (`./core.js`, …) only if they are not loaded yet |
| `<out>/aramin-console.{css,js}` | a **custom build** with only the modules you chose (+ their dependencies) |

All bundles share one registry (`globalThis.__AC_MODS__`): a module is evaluated once, whichever bundle brought it.

## Include all
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/aramin-console.min.css">
<script type="module" src="dist/aramin-console.min.js"></script>
```

## Include some (custom build)
```bash
node scripts/build.mjs --modules=forms,table,chart --out=dist/custom        # core + forms + table (+ data-display) + chart
```
or put an `aramin.config.json` in your project and run the package's build from there:
```json
{ "modules": ["shell", "overlays", "forms", "table"], "out": "public/aramin", "name": "aramin-console", "modulesBase": "/aramin/modules/" }
```
```bash
node node_modules/aramin-console/scripts/build.mjs            # reads ./aramin.config.json
node node_modules/aramin-console/scripts/build.mjs --config=path/to/aramin.config.json
```
Builds outside the package copy `fonts/` and `icons.svg` next to the bundle. `modulesBase` tells `AC.use()` where the
per-module files are served from (copy `dist/modules/` there if you lazy-load). The demo itself is a custom build:
[`demo/aramin.config.json`](../demo/aramin.config.json).

## Remove one
* **Full bundle:** set `"bundle": false` in `src/modules/<name>/module.json` (or in `src/modules.json`) and rebuild.
* **Custom build:** just don't list it.
* A whole `src/modules/<name>` folder can be deleted — the manifest picks that up (run `--sync-manifest` to tidy `src/modules.json`).
Dependants are reported at build time (`module x imports from "y" — add it to its dependencies`).

## Lazy-load
```js
await AC.use('maps');                    // JS + CSS of maps and its dependencies, once; CSS is awaited (no flash)
const [chart, table] = await AC.use('chart', 'table');
AC.use.preload('marketing');             // <link rel="modulepreload"> (e.g. on hover of a link)
AC.use.loaded('maps') · AC.use.list() · AC.use.base = 'https://cdn.example/aramin/dist/modules/'
```
Module CSS is inserted right after the framework stylesheet (`link[data-ac-css]`), so app / page stylesheets after it still win.
A `.min` bundle lazy-loads `.min` modules. The page router of the demo does this per page:
the build writes a page → modules map (from `data-ac`, `data-ac-*`, owned block classes and `AC.<api>` used by the page script),
and a fragment can add `data-modules="maps marketing"`. Event: `ac:module:load {name}`.

**Measured on the demo dashboard** (cold load, gzip): before (full bundle) JS 333 KB + CSS 110 KB → after (shell build + lazy
`chart`) JS 117 KB + CSS 44 KB.

## Write a module
`src/modules/<name>/<name>.js` (+ `<name>.css`, optional `module.json`). Contract — see [`src/modules/README.md`](../src/modules/README.md):
```js
export function install(AC) {
  if (!AC || AC.hello) return AC?.hello;
  AC.hello = (el, cfg) => { /* … */ };
  AC.register?.('hello', (el) => { /* init */ return () => { /* destroy */ }; });
  return AC.hello;
}
if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.AC) install(window.AC);
```
```json
// src/modules/hello/module.json (optional)
{ "description": "What it does", "dependencies": ["overlays"], "bundle": true }
```
* No `import` of core files — use the `AC` you are given (works bundled, per-module and straight from `src/`).
* Inject your stylesheet once with `<link data-ac-module="hello">` from `new URL('./hello.css', import.meta.url)`; bundles mark
  their own CSS as present, and the bundler points `import.meta.url` at `dist/modules/` so the URL always exists.
* Bundler syntax: `import {a} from './x.js'`, `export function|const|class`, `export {…}`, `export … from`. No default exports.
* Run `npm run build` — the module appears in the size table, in `dist/modules/`, in the full bundle and in `AC.use()`.

## Build safety nets
* `node tests/build.mjs` — the minifier keeps strings / regexes / templates / ASI (tricky fixture is evaluated before and after),
  every emitted bundle parses, and a custom build evaluates with exactly the chosen modules.
* The build fails when any file referenced from `demo/` (HTML `src`/`href`, JS imports, CSS `url()`, SW precache list,
  manifest icons) is missing.

<!-- ===== docs/motion.md ===== -->

# Motion system

Files: `src/css/tokens.css` (motion tokens), `src/css/motion.css` (system + micro-interactions, built **last** so it refines every component), `src/js/motion.js` (`AC.motion`). Bar: Emil Kowalski / Linear / Vercel — fast, purposeful, interruptible.

## Rules of the house
- Animate only `transform`, `opacity`, `filter`, `clip-path`. Colour changes use `--ac-ease-hover`.
- Entering / exiting → ease-out curves. Moving on screen → ease-in-out or a spring. **Never ease-in.**
- Exits are faster than entrances (`--ac-dur-exit`). UI stays under 300 ms; sheets ride the drawer curve (~420 ms).
- Press feedback on `:active` at once (100 ms in, spring back out). Hover *motion* only under `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
- Keyboard-driven changes are instant (highlight moves, palette rows): things used 100×/day must not wait for animation.
- Popovers scale from their trigger (`--ac-origin`, set by position.js); modals scale from the centre.

## Tokens
| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ac-ease` | `cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)` | default UI ease-out |
| `--ac-ease-out` | `cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)` | expo-out: reveals, lifts, stagger |
| `--ac-ease-in-out` | `cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1)` | on-screen movement, chart line draw |
| `--ac-ease-move` | `cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1)` | slides / panels |
| `--ac-ease-drawer` | `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)` | sheets, drawers (iOS / Vaul) |
| `--ac-spring` + `--ac-spring-dur` | `linear(…)` 400 ms | real spring k=520 c=34 (2.9 % overshoot) sampled into `linear()` — pills, thumbs, cards |
| `--ac-spring-bounce` + `-dur` | `linear(…)` 700 ms | k=380 c=20 (15 %) — icons, checks, badges (rare, playful) |
| `--ac-dur-0…4`, `--ac-dur-sheet`, `--ac-dur-exit` | 100 / 140 / 180 / 240 / 300 / 420 / 140 ms | |
| `--ac-stagger` | 45 ms | sibling entrance step (capped at 7 steps) |
| `--ac-press`, `--ac-press-sm`, `--ac-lift` | `scale(.97)`, `scale(.92)`, `translateY(-4px)` | |
| `--ac-dir` | `1` / `-1` | inline direction multiplier for `translateX` (see rtl.md) |
| `--ac-travel` | `1` / `0` | distance factor; `0` under reduced motion |

## `AC.motion` (JS)
```js
AC.motion.spring(el, { x: 120, scale: [0.9, 1], opacity: 1 }, { stiffness, damping, mass }) // WAAPI, interruptible, keeps velocity
AC.motion.springValue(0, 100, { onUpdate: (v) => … })      // rAF spring for anything that is not a transform
AC.motion.slide(indicator, { x, w, y?, h? }, { instant, also: [layer] }) // indicator geometry; leading edge stiffer → stretch
AC.motion.inkLayer(container, '.item')                     // Emil's duplicate-and-clip: label colour flips exactly under the pill
AC.motion.track(container, { active: '[data-active]' })     // ink pill that springs to the active child (dock uses it)
AC.motion.highlight(list, { items: '.row' })               // sliding hover highlight for a custom list
AC.motion.followSelection(list)                            // one indicator follows the aria-selected row (palette)
AC.motion.flip(targets, () => mutate())                    // FLIP layout transition
AC.motion.stagger(els, keyframes, { step: 45 }) · enter(els)
AC.motion.countUp(el, 1234, { format }) · bump(badge) · reveal(contentThatReplacedASkeleton)
AC.motion.transition(update, { kind: 'page'|'lang'|'theme', direction })   // View Transitions
AC.motion.navigate(update, { from, to })                   // page transition; direction from nav order
AC.motion.springEasing(springs.gentle) → { easing: 'linear(…)', duration }
AC.motion.preference = 'system' | 'full' | 'reduced'       // persisted (ac:motion)
```
Declarative: `data-ac="bump"` (count bumps when its text changes; shell badges get it automatically), `data-ac="motion-pref"` (System / Full / Reduced segmented control for settings pages), `data-ac="counter"` (count-up).

## What moves where
- **Navigation**: top nav, segmented, pill tabs, tab bar and dock share one spring indicator with stretch + ink layer. Route changes mark the target link *before* fetching, so the pill answers the click at once. Only `.ac-content` is captured by the page View Transition (`:root` is excluded) — the chrome stays live and keeps animating. Pages slide toward the direction of travel in the nav (mirrored in RTL) with a 2 px blur bridge.
- **Lists**: menus, rail flyout, language picker get a sliding hover highlight (instant on keyboard); the command palette has one indicator for hover + arrow keys.
- **Overlays**: dropdown/popover scale .95 → 1 from the trigger in 180 ms, exit in 140 ms; tooltips delay 450 ms, then neighbours open instantly with no animation; modals scale from centre; sheets/drawers use the drawer curve; menus on phones become action sheets.
- **Controls**: buttons press .97 and spring back; loading morphs (label blurs out, spinner pops in); switch thumb springs with squash; checkbox check is drawn (clip reveal); radio dot bounces; focus ring grows; float labels glide.
- **Data**: KPI count-ups; bars grow from the baseline column by column (`--i`, `--_base`) with a spring; lines draw (`stroke-dashoffset`); donut sweeps; hover dims other columns; tooltip follows on a spring (transform only); legend hover spotlights a series; legend toggle and `update()` morph paths (CSS `d`) instead of jumping; bulk bar springs in.
- **Shell**: staggered card entrance; card hover lift; language switch = whole-document blur crossfade; theme switch = circular reveal from the pressed control; badges bump; tab icon pops.

## Reduced motion — a preference, not a kill switch
`<html data-motion="full|reduced">` is resolved pre-paint by `boot.js` from `ac:motion` (`system` follows `prefers-reduced-motion`). Windows with "Animation effects" off makes every browser report *reduce* — users who still want the full experience pick **Full** in the customizer («حرکت و انیمیشن») or a settings page (`data-ac="motion-pref"`).

Reduced keeps fades, colour, blur crossfades, count-ups, chart reveals and page/language crossfades; it drops travel (every keyframe multiplies its distance by `--ac-travel`), springs (JS jumps to the end state), transform transitions (`transition-property` is limited to non-spatial properties) and decorative loops (shimmer, pulse). `data-motion="off"` still turns everything off. In JS, `AC.reducedMotion()` means "skip spatial motion", not "skip all feedback".

## Verifying motion
Slow it down: CDP `Animation.setPlaybackRate` (0.1–0.25) for CSS/WAAPI, and `AC.motion.timeScale` for rAF springs; capture frames at fixed animation times. Test both `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` with preference `system` and `full`. rAF springs are measured in-page (screenshots stall frames).

<!-- ===== docs/notifications.md ===== -->

# Notifications — `AC.notify`

Module `notify` (`src/modules/notify/`). Builds on the existing `AC.toast` and `AC.notifications` (docs/overlays.md — unchanged).
Live playground: `demo/#/notify-lab`. Tests: `node tests/notify.mjs --base=…`.

```js
AC.notify('Saved');                                          // toast
AC.notify({
  variant: 'toast' | 'card' | 'banner' | 'inline' | 'snackbar' | 'progress' | 'island' | 'system' | 'center',
  title, text, tone: 'neutral|accent|success|warning|danger|info', icon, avatar: 'ع‌ر' | { src }, image, meta,
  actions: [{ label, primary, keep, onClick(handle) }],
  position: 'top-start|top-center|top-end|bottom-start|bottom-center|bottom-end',   // logical: start = right in RTL
  duration: 6000 /* 0 = sticky */, priority: 'low|normal|high|urgent', group: 'chat:42',
  sound: true, haptic: true, swipe: 'x' | 'y', target /* inline */, onUndo /* snackbar */, onClose(reason), href, id,
  event: 'mention',                                           // route through the user's preferences instead of a fixed variant
});
// → { id, el, variant, close(reason), update(patch) }   progress: update({ progress: .4 }), done(text), fail(text)
AC.notify.toast|card|banner|inline|snackbar|progress|island|system|center(opts) · AC.notify.clear(variant?)
```
Text fields accept `{ fa, en, ar }`. Mixed-script lines take the direction of their first strong letter.

## Variants
| Variant | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `toast` | `AC.toast` (Sonner-like stack). `group` collapses repeats into one toast with a count. |
| `card` | rich card — avatar or icon, title + meta, body, image, actions; stacked per position, newest at the edge, **max visible** (prefs, default 3) with a "+N more" control that expands the stack; hover/focus pauses the timer; swipe to dismiss (`x` or `y`). |
| `progress` | card with a progress bar; `update({ progress })`, `done()` turns it green and auto-closes, `fail()`. |
| `banner` | full-width top bar (tone colours), one at a time, queued; `urgent` jumps the queue; pushes top stacks down. |
| `snackbar` | inverse pill at the bottom with countdown ring and **Undo** (`onUndo`; `onCommit` when it expires). One at a time. |
| `island` | "dynamic island" — black pill at the top centre; tap / hover / `expand: true` springs it open (text, progress, actions); `update({ badge, progress })` while it lives. |
| `inline` | `.ac-alert` rendered inside `target` (dismissible). |
| `system` | Notification API (through the service worker when present, so it works with actions); falls back to a toast without permission. |
| `center` | adds to the notification center (`AC.notifications.add`). |

## Preferences — per user, per event type
```js
AC.notify.events.define({ id: 'deploy', label: { fa: 'استقرار', en: 'Deploys' }, icon: 'rocket',
  defaults: { inapp: 'island', center: true, system: false, sound: false } });
AC.notify({ event: 'deploy', title: 'v2.4 is live' });       // in-app variant + inbox + system (when the tab is hidden) + sound
AC.notify.prefs() · AC.notify.setPrefs({ position, sound, haptic, quiet, max, swipe, events: { deploy: { system: true } } })
<div data-ac="notify-prefs"></div>                          // settings card: global switches, position picker, push, matrix
```
Built-in event types: `mention`, `order`, `invoice`, `security`, `system`, `marketing`. **Do not disturb** (`quiet`) silences routed
notifications except `urgent`; direct calls (an undo snackbar after the user's own action) are never silenced. Preferences live in
`localStorage['ac:notify']`; event `ac:notify:prefs`.

**Sound** is synthesized (WebAudio, no asset) and off by default; **haptics** use `navigator.vibrate` with a pattern per priority.

## Web Push
```js
await AC.notify.permission();                                 // 'granted' | 'denied' | 'default' | 'unsupported'
await AC.notify.push.subscribe({ vapidKey: 'B…', endpoint: '/api/push/subscribe' });   // POSTs the PushSubscription JSON
await AC.notify.push.unsubscribe({ endpoint: '/api/push/subscribe' });                  // DELETE { endpoint }
await AC.notify.push.state();                                 // 'subscribed' | 'simulated' | 'off' | 'blocked' | 'unsupported'
AC.notify.push.simulate({ title, body, url, tone });          // demo: runs the SW push handler (or an in-page card)
```
The settings card takes `data-vapid-key` / `data-endpoint`; without a key it uses **demo mode** (simulated push).
The service worker (`demo/sw.js`) shows the notification on `push`, echoes it to open pages (`{type:'PUSH'}` → added to the inbox)
and on `notificationclick` focuses or opens the app at `data.url`.

**Server setup (VAPID)** — keys are never committed:
```bash
npx web-push generate-vapid-keys            # once; keep the private key in your secret store
```
```php
// PHP (minishlink/web-push): send to a stored subscription
$push = new Minishlink\WebPush\WebPush(['VAPID' => ['subject' => 'mailto:ops@example.com',
  'publicKey' => getenv('VAPID_PUBLIC'), 'privateKey' => getenv('VAPID_PRIVATE')]]);
$push->sendOneNotification(Minishlink\WebPush\Subscription::create($subscriptionArray),
  json_encode(['title' => 'Invoice paid', 'body' => '#1204 · 4,800,000 IRR', 'url' => '/#/finance', 'tag' => 'invoice']));
```
```js
// Node (web-push)
webpush.setVapidDetails('mailto:ops@example.com', process.env.VAPID_PUBLIC, process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE);
await webpush.sendNotification(subscription, JSON.stringify({ title: 'Invoice paid', body: '#1204', url: '/#/finance' }));
```
Payload fields the worker understands: `title, body, icon, image, url, tag|group, priority ('urgent' → requireInteraction), actions[{action,title}]`.

## Events
`ac:notify:show {variant,id}` · `ac:notify:close {variant,id,reason}` · `ac:notify:action {id,label}` · `ac:notify:prefs` ·
`ac:notify:click` (system / push notification clicked) · `ac:notify:push-state {state}`.

## Accessibility & motion
Cards / banners / snackbars are `role="status"` (danger / urgent: `alert`) inside `aria-live` regions; every close button is labelled;
the island is keyboard-operable (Enter / Space toggles, Esc closes); timers pause on hover and focus; reduced motion removes
movement and timers' visual bars.

<!-- ===== docs/overlays.md ===== -->

# Overlays & feedback

Modal, bottom sheet, drawer, dropdown / context menu / action sheet, popover, tooltip, confirm & prompt,
toast, alert / banner, notification center and the theme customizer.
Files: `src/js/components/{position,sheet,modal,drawer,menu,popover,tooltip,toast,confirm,alert,notifications,customizer}.js`,
`src/css/components/{overlay,feedback}.css`. Live demo: `demo/#/overlays`, `demo/#/notifications`. Tests: `node tests/overlays.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178`.

Visual language (docs/DESIGN.md): white `--ac-elevated` surfaces, `--ac-r-2xl` radius, hairline `--ac-border`, one soft large shadow,
black pill primary (`.ac-btn--primary`) and gray pill secondary in footers. Tokens only — dark mode is a token swap.

## Shared behaviour
- Every layer is portaled to `<body>` while open and put back afterwards, so it escapes transformed / clipped parents.
  Closed layers are `display: none` (`data-state="closed"`); during the exit animation `data-state="closing"`.
- One layer stack (`AC.layers`): **Esc** and **outside click** go to the top-most layer only. Navigation (`hashchange`) closes all.
- Dialog layers (modal / sheet / drawer / confirm): `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`, labelled by `.ac-dialog__title`
  and described by `.ac-dialog__text`; focus trap (`AC.trapFocus`); focus returns to the trigger; `AC.scrollLock` (ref-counted).
- Generic triggers: `[data-ac-open="#id"]` opens/toggles any modal, sheet, drawer, dropdown or popover; `[data-ac-close]` inside closes
  (its value becomes the close `reason`).
- Reduced motion: CSS durations are globally zeroed; JS timers skip animation when `AC.reducedMotion()`.

## Dialog markup (modal / sheet / drawer share it)
```html
<button class="ac-btn" data-ac-open="#new-ws">New workspace</button>
<div class="ac-modal" id="new-ws" data-ac="modal" data-size="md" data-initial="#ws-name">
  <div class="ac-dialog">
    <div class="ac-dialog__head">
      <div class="ac-dialog__titles"><h2 class="ac-dialog__title">Create workspace</h2><p class="ac-dialog__sub">…</p></div>
      <button class="ac-dialog__close" data-ac-close aria-label="Close"><svg class="ac-icon"><use href="#i-x"/></svg></button>
    </div>
    <div class="ac-dialog__body">…</div>
    <div class="ac-dialog__foot">
      <button class="ac-btn" data-ac-close>Cancel</button>
      <button class="ac-btn ac-btn--primary" data-ac-close="save">Create</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
| Attribute | Applies to | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `data-size="sm\|md\|lg\|xl\|full"` | modal | width 26 / 32 / 48 / 64 rem / full |
| `data-size="sm\|lg"`, `data-side="start\|end"` | drawer | 22 / 36 rem; logical side (RTL-aware) |
| `data-snap="0.5,0.92"`, `data-snap-start="0"` | sheet | snap points as viewport fractions |
| `data-static` | all | Esc / backdrop do not close; the panel "bumps" instead |
| `data-initial="#sel"` | all | element focused on open (else `[autofocus]`, else the panel) |

**Phones (<640px):** a modal presents as a bottom sheet automatically (grab handle, drag-to-dismiss, safe-area padding).
Sheets: drag the handle/head (or anywhere when the inner scroller is at the top) — rubber-band above the top snap,
velocity flick (`|vy| > 0.5 px/ms`) goes to the next snap or dismisses, a resting release snaps to the nearest point,
the backdrop fades with the drag below the lowest snap. Drawers dismiss by swiping toward their edge.

API: `AC.modal.open('#id' | el | { title, sub, content, footer, size, static, initial })`, `AC.modal.close([target])`,
same for `AC.sheet` (`snap`) and `AC.drawer` (`side`). Object form builds an ephemeral layer removed after close.
`AC.instance(el, 'modal')` → `{ open, close, toggle, bump, snapTo, isOpen }`.
Events: `ac:<kind>:open {trigger}`, `ac:<kind>:beforeclose {reason}` (cancelable), `ac:<kind>:close {reason}`, `ac:<kind>:closed`, `ac:sheet:snap {index, value}`.

## Confirm & prompt
```js
if (await AC.confirm({ tone: 'danger', title: 'Delete project?', text: '…', confirmText: 'Delete' })) …
const name = await AC.prompt({ title: 'Rename', label: 'New name', value: 'a.pdf', required: true,
  validate: (v) => v.endsWith('.pdf') || 'Must end with .pdf' });   // string | null
```
Tone `danger|warning|success|info|accent` sets the icon and (danger) the red confirm button; danger dialogs focus *Cancel*.
`role="alertdialog"`; centred on desktop, sheet on phones.

## Menus
```html
<button class="ac-btn" data-ac-open="#m">Actions</button>
<div class="ac-menu" id="m" data-ac="dropdown" data-placement="bottom-end" aria-label="Actions">
  <div class="ac-menu__label">Edit</div>
  <button class="ac-menu__item" data-value="dup"><svg class="ac-icon">…</svg><span class="ac-menu__text">Duplicate</span><kbd class="ac-menu__kbd">Ctrl D</kbd></button>
  <div class="ac-menu__sub"><button class="ac-menu__item"><span class="ac-menu__text">Share</span></button><div class="ac-menu">…</div></div>
  <div class="ac-menu__sep"></div>
  <button class="ac-menu__item" role="menuitemcheckbox" aria-checked="true">Show grid</button>
  <div role="group"><button class="ac-menu__item" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">Newest</button>…</div>
  <button class="ac-menu__item" data-tone="danger">Delete</button>
</div>
<div data-ac-contextmenu="#m" tabindex="0">right-click / long-press here</div>
```
Keyboard: ↑ ↓ Home End, type-ahead, Enter/Space, → / ← (mirrored in RTL) for submenus, Esc, Tab closes. Roving tabindex,
`aria-haspopup` / `aria-expanded` on triggers. Checkbox / radio items keep the menu open (`data-keep` does it for any item).
Context menus: right click, the ContextMenu key / Shift+F10, or a 480 ms long-press on touch (with haptic).
**Phones:** every top-level menu becomes an action sheet with a Cancel button; submenus expand inline.
Imperative: `AC.menu(anchor | {x,y} | event, items, { placement, keyboard })` with
`items = [{ label, icon, shortcut, tone, disabled, value, checked, radio:'group', keep, onSelect(item), items:[…] }, '-', { heading }]`;
`AC.menu.open('#m', anchorOrEvent)`, `AC.menu.close()`, `AC.menu.context(el, items)`.
Event: `ac:menu:select { item, value, checked }`.

## Popover, tooltip, positioning
```html
<button data-ac-open="#invite">Invite</button>
<div class="ac-popover" id="invite" data-ac="popover" data-placement="bottom-start" aria-label="Invite">…</div>
<button data-ac-tooltip="Copy link" data-ac-tooltip-kbd="Ctrl C" data-ac-tooltip-placement="top" aria-label="Copy">…</button>
```
Popovers are non-modal: light dismiss (outside click, Esc, focus leaving), focus returns to the trigger.
`AC.popover.open|close|toggle(target, anchor)`, `AC.popover.show(anchor, { content, placement })`.
Tooltips: mouse hover after 450 ms (instant while "warm"), keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`), never on touch; one shared
`role="tooltip"` linked with `aria-describedby`; Esc hides.

`AC.position(anchor, panel, { placement:'bottom-start', offset, padding, flip, shift })` — placement `<side>-<align>`,
side `top|bottom|start|end|left|right`, align `start|center|end`; logical values follow `dir`. Flips to the side with room,
shifts inside the viewport, writes `--ac-x/--ac-y/--ac-origin/--ac-avail-h` and `data-side`. `AC.autoPosition()` keeps it
in place on scroll / resize and returns `stop()`.

## Toasts
```js
AC.toast({ title: 'Saved', text: 'All changes synced', tone: 'success', duration: 4500, position: 'bottom-end',
           action: { label: 'View', onClick(t) {} } });
AC.toast.success|error|warning|info(title, text?, opts?)
AC.toast.undo('3 messages archived', () => restore());
AC.toast.promise(fetch(…), { loading: 'Saving…', success: 'Saved', error: (e) => e.message });
AC.toast.dismiss(id?)   // returns of AC.toast(): { id, el, close(), update(patch) }
```
Stacked (newest in front, the rest peek behind), expand on hover / focus / tap, timers pause while expanded or the tab is hidden,
progress bar, swipe sideways to dismiss (velocity aware), max 5. Container: `#ac-toasts` (else created);
`position` creates per-position containers. On phones toasts sit at the top. Events `ac:toast:open`, `ac:toast:close {reason}`.

## Alerts / banners
```html
<div class="ac-alert" data-tone="warning" data-ac="alert" data-persist="storage-80" role="status">
  <svg class="ac-icon ac-alert__icon"><use href="#i-triangle-alert"/></svg>
  <div class="ac-alert__body"><div class="ac-alert__title">…</div><div class="ac-alert__text">…</div><div class="ac-alert__actions">…</div></div>
  <button class="ac-alert__close" data-ac-close aria-label="Dismiss">…</button>
</div>
```
Variants `.ac-alert--solid`, `--outline`, `--banner`. `data-ac="alert"` makes it dismissible (animated collapse);
`data-persist` remembers the dismissal (`AC.alertReset(key)`). Event `ac:alert:close` (cancelable).

## Notification center
Shell wiring: put **`data-ac-notifications-open`** on the bell (button or link — a plain click opens the panel, Ctrl/⌘-click
follows the link) and **`data-ac-notifications-src="pages/notifications.json"`** on it (or call `AC.notifications.set(list)`).
A `.ac-appbar__count` inside the bell, or any `[data-ac-notifications-count]`, shows the unread count (hidden at 0).
Desktop: anchored panel (tabs All/Unread, grouped Today/Earlier, mark all read, "view all" link). Phones: full-height sheet.
Page view: `<div data-ac="notifications" data-mode="page" data-src="…json"></div>` (adds Mentions/System tabs and a per-row menu
with mark read/unread and remove + undo toast).
Item: `{ id, title, text, time | ago (minutes), icon, tone, avatar, color, kind, read, href }` — `title`/`text`/`avatar` may be `{ fa, en, ar }`.
API: `AC.notifications.set|add(item, {toast})|markRead(id, read)|markAllRead()|remove(id)|load(url)|open(anchor)|close()|toggle()`, `.list`, `.unread`.
Events: `ac:notifications:change { unread }`, `ac:notifications:select { item }`.

## Theme customizer
Any **`data-ac-customizer-open`** element opens the drawer (end side): theme light / dark / system with previews, accent swatches
(`AC.theme.accents`), density, radius, language & direction (fa / en / ar), digits (Latin / Persian), reset. It writes through
`AC.theme.set`, `AC.i18n.set`, `AC.i18n.setDigits`, stays in sync with changes made elsewhere, and registers the palette
command `customizer:open`. API: `AC.customizer.open|close|toggle()`.

## i18n keys
`overlay.*` (framework strings: close, cancel, confirm, delete, undo, …), `notif.*`, `custom.*`; the demo page uses `ov.*`.

<!-- ===== docs/prose.md ===== -->

# Prose & Markdown

Module: `src/modules/prose/` (`prose.js`, `markdown.js`, `prose.css`). It ships in the full bundle and as `dist/modules/prose.{js,css}` for `AC.use('prose')`. It depends on `data-display` (code blocks reuse the code component). Demo: `#/article`, `#/docs` (this page), `#/blog`, `#/editor`. Tests: `node tests/prose.mjs` (no browser needed).

## Markdown → safe HTML

```js
const html = AC.markdown('# Hello **world**');              // string
const { html, headings, words } = AC.markdown.render(text, { lang: 'fa' });
```

```php
<?php
// Server side: render with your PHP library, then put the result inside the same class.
echo '<div class="ac-prose">' . $html . '</div>';
```

Supported: ATX and setext headings, paragraphs, hard breaks, `**strong**`, `*em*`, `~~strike~~`, `` `code` ``, fenced and indented code, block quotes, nested bullet / ordered / task lists, GFM tables with alignment, `---`, inline / reference / auto links, bare `https://` and `www.` links, images (an image alone in a paragraph becomes a `<figure>` with a caption), footnotes `[^1]`, callouts and containers:

```md
> [!NOTE]            note · tip · important · warning · caution · danger
> Body text

:::details Click to open
Hidden text
:::
```

Keyboard keys and a few inline tags work as bare tags only: `<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>`, `<sub>`, `<sup>`, `<mark>`, `<ins>`, `<del>`, `<s>`, `<small>`, `<abbr>`, `<br>`.

### Safety

- Every piece of text is escaped. Raw HTML is shown as text; there is no option to allow it. If you need HTML, clean it yourself on the server.
- Tags with attributes (`<kbd onclick=…>`) are text. Allowed bare tags are always closed and balanced.
- Links allow `http`, `https`, `mailto`, `tel` and relative URLs. Images allow `http(s)` and relative URLs; `data:image/png|jpeg|gif|webp` only with `allowDataImages: true`. The check runs after removing control characters and whitespace, so `java\tscript:` and `&#106;avascript:` are refused.
- External links get `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow"`.
- Heading ids are generated from the text and never start with `ac-`, so they cannot clash with framework ids.

### Options

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `lang` | UI language | Callout titles and footnote labels (`fa`, `en`, `ar`) |
| `labels` | — | Override any label: `{ note, tip, warning, footnotes, backref, anchor }` |
| `idPrefix` | `''` | Prefix for heading and footnote ids |
| `headingIds` / `anchors` | `true` | Ids on headings / the `#` link shown on hover |
| `link(href)` / `image(src)` | — | Rewrite URLs (for example docs links to router links). The result is still checked. |
| `codeComponent` | `true` | Emit `<div class="ac-code" data-ac="code">` (copy button + language label) |
| `linkTarget` | `'_blank'` | Target for external links (`''` to keep them in the tab) |

## Typography — `.ac-prose`

Put any long text inside `<div class="ac-prose">`. It sets the reading measure (about 70 characters), the heading scale, list markers, quotes, callouts, zebra tables that scroll sideways on phones, captions, footnotes and keyboard keys.

- Every paragraph, list item, heading and table cell finds its own direction (`unicode-bidi: plaintext`), so an English sentence in a Persian article lines up on the left. Code is always left-to-right.
- Persian numbers in ordered lists: `data-numerals="persian"` (or `"arabic"`) on the `.ac-prose` element or on one `<ol>`.
- A bigger first paragraph: `.ac-prose--lead`, or `.ac-lead` on one paragraph.

## Article chrome

```js
const prose = AC.prose(el, { markdown: text, anchorUrl: (id) => `#/article?h=${id}` });
const article = AC.article(rootEl, { content: el, toc: tocListEl });
prose.minutes;      // reading time (200 words a minute)
```

- `AC.prose(el, { markdown | html, lightbox: true, anchorUrl })` renders and enhances: heading anchors (a click scrolls and, with `anchorUrl`, copies the link), images open in a lightbox that grows from the picture, in-page links scroll smoothly without touching a hash router. API: `set(md)`, `setHtml(html)`, `scrollTo(id)`, `headings`, `words`, `minutes`, `destroy()`.
- `AC.article(el, { content, toc, progress: true, levels: [2, 3] })` adds the reading progress bar at the top of the window and builds the table of contents with scroll-spy (the active entry is marked `aria-current` and a small accent bar slides to it). Put the list inside `<details class="ac-toc">`: it stays open on desktop and collapses on phones. API: `refresh()`, `destroy()`.
- Declarative: `<div data-ac="prose" data-src="post.md"></div>` fetches and renders a file.
- Events: `ac:prose:render {headings, words, minutes}`, `ac:prose:anchor {id}`, `ac:toc:change {id}`.

Ready-made classes for the rest of an article page: `.ac-article` (main + sticky aside), `.ac-article__card`, `.ac-article__head/__title/__sub/__meta`, `.ac-tags > .ac-tag`, `.ac-share`, `.ac-author`, `.ac-pager > .ac-pager__link[data-dir=prev|next]`, `.ac-posts > .ac-post-card(--feature)`, `.ac-comments`, `.ac-compose`, `.ac-comment-list > .ac-comment`. Docs layout: `.ac-docs` with `.ac-docs__nav` (`details.ac-doctree`), `.ac-docs__main`, `.ac-docs__toc`. Editor: `.ac-mde` with `.ac-mde__bar`, `.ac-mde__tool`, `.ac-mde__panes`, `.ac-mde__src`, `.ac-mde__preview`, `.ac-mde__status` (`data-view="write|preview"` on phones).

## Motion

Reduced motion keeps fades and colour changes: the lightbox fades instead of growing, the table of contents switches without sliding, details panels fade open. Spatial movement uses `--ac-travel`, which is `0` under `data-motion="reduced"`.

## Auth animations (forms module)

The OTP and password inputs got framework-level feedback (see `docs/forms.md`):

- OTP: boxes stagger in, a typed digit pops, the focused box glows, a paste fills the boxes with a wave. `AC.instance(el,'otp').error({ clear })` shakes toward the start edge, tints red and vibrates; `.success()` turns the boxes green one by one and folds them into a check circle that draws itself (returns a promise); `.reset()`. Events `ac:otp:error`, `ac:otp:success`.
- Password: `data-checklist` shows rules that tick with a drawn check; the strength bars fill with a spring and change colour; the eye blinks when showing or hiding; a Caps Lock warning slides in (`data-caps="false"` turns it off).

Every one of these uses the Web Animations API with a reduced-motion version that keeps opacity and colour, because Windows with "Animation effects" off makes every browser report reduced motion.

<!-- ===== docs/pwa.md ===== -->

# PWA — install, offline, updates

Module `pwa` (`src/modules/pwa/`), service worker template `demo/sw.js`, manifest `demo/manifest.webmanifest`.
Live: `demo/#/notify-lab`. Tests: `node tests/pwa.mjs` (runs its own server; sub-path `/AraminConsole/`).

## Register
```js
AC.pwa.register('sw.js', { updateUI: 'toast' /* | 'banner' | false */, network: true, badge: true, onUpdate(worker) {} });
```
* **Update flow:** a new build installs a new worker that **waits**. The page shows an "Update available" toast (or banner);
  *Reload* posts `SKIP_WAITING` → the worker activates, deletes old caches, claims the page → exactly one reload. The very
  first install never reloads. `AC.pwa.update()` checks now (also done when the tab becomes visible, at most every 30 min);
  `AC.pwa.simulateUpdate()` shows the UI for demos.
* **No stale caches:** the build stamps `const BUILD = '<hash>'` into `demo/sw.js`, so every build is a new worker and a new cache name.
* `network: true` → offline / back-online toasts, `html[data-offline]`. `badge: true` → app badge = notification-center unread.

## Service worker (demo/sw.js — copy it for your app)
| Request | Strategy |
|---|---|
| app shell (precache list) | installed with the worker, versioned cache |
| `dist/**`, `*.js`, `*.css`, page fragments, i18n | stale-while-revalidate |
| fonts, icons, images | cache-first |
| data (`*.json`, `api/*` GET) | network-first, cache fallback |
| navigations | network-first → cached shell → offline: redirect to `errors/offline.html?from=<url>` |
| `POST api/*` while offline | stored in IndexedDB, answered `202` + `X-AC-Queued: 1`, replayed on `sync` ("ac-outbox") or `FLUSH` |

Every URL is relative to the worker, so it works under a sub-path (GitHub Pages). Page side:
`const { ok, queued } = await AC.pwa.send('api/notes', { body })` · `AC.pwa.flush()` (called automatically on `online`).
Events: `ac:pwa:queued {count}`, `ac:pwa:synced {count}`, `ac:pwa:update`, `ac:pwa:offline|online`.

## Install invitation — `AC.install`
```js
AC.install.show('sheet' | 'banner' | 'card' | 'inline' | 'ios', { target, app: { name, icon }, stats, benefits });
AC.install.prompt();     // browser prompt (Chrome/Edge/Android) · iOS steps sheet · or "use the browser menu" hint
AC.install.auto({ minVisits: 2, minSeconds: 25, snoozeDays: 7, variant });   // smart timing
AC.install.state         // { available, installed, standalone, platform: 'ios'|'android'|'desktop', canPromptIOS, visits, snoozedUntil }
AC.install.snooze(days) · AC.install.hide() · AC.install.reset()
<div data-ac="install-card"></div>                     <!-- inline settings card; shows "Installed ✓" once installed -->
```
* `beforeinstallprompt` is captured (and its mini-infobar suppressed) as soon as the module loads; `appinstalled` → thanks toast.
* **Sheet:** app icon + name (localized from `name_localized`), App-Store-like stats row, screenshots carousel from the manifest
  (narrow on phones, wide on desktop), four benefits, black *Install* pill + *Not now* (snoozes). Phones: bottom sheet.
* **Banner:** glass pill at the top. **Card:** floating card at the end corner (above the tab bar on phones). **Inline:** settings card.
* **iOS Safari:** three animated SVG steps (Share → Add to Home Screen → Add); reduced motion stops the loops.
* Timing: visits are counted once per session; nothing shows before `minVisits`, during a snooze, when installed or standalone.

## Manifest checklist (demo/manifest.webmanifest)
`id`, `scope`, `start_url`, `lang`/`dir`, `name` + `name_localized` (fa/en/ar), `display_override`
(`window-controls-overlay`, `standalone`), icons incl. **maskable** 192/512, `shortcuts` (Dashboard, Tickets, Chat, New invoice
with 96 px icons), `screenshots` (wide 1280×800 + narrow 780×1688), `share_target` (GET → the app shows a card with what was
shared), `theme_color`/`background_color` + `user_preferences.color_scheme_dark`, `launch_handler`.
Regenerate icons and screenshots: `node tests/make-pwa-assets.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178`.

## App-like extras
`AC.pwa.badge(n)` (App Badging API) · `AC.pwa.share({ title, text, url, files })` (Web Share, falls back to copying the link) ·
`AC.pwa.isStandalone()` · `html[data-standalone]` (no overscroll glow, no text selection in chrome) and `html[data-platform]` ·
window-controls-overlay keeps the top bar clear of the title-bar buttons · `AC.pwa.splash({ minMs })` (standalone launches only).

<!-- ===== docs/rtl.md ===== -->

# RTL / LTR

AraminConsole is RTL-first (fa, ar) and must be pixel-correct in LTR (en). `i18n.set(lang)` sets `<html lang dir>`; every layout mirrors through CSS logical properties. Check with `node tests/rtl.mjs` (static scan + rendered geometry; `--static` for the scan only).

## Rules
1. **Logical properties only**: `margin/padding-inline-start|end`, `inset-inline-start|end`, `border-inline-*`, `border-start-start-radius…`, `text-align: start|end`, `inline-size/block-size`. The scanner rejects `margin-left`, `padding-right`, `border-left`, `left:`/`right:`, `text-align:left|right`, `float`, `*-left-radius` and literal `translateX(±n)`.
2. **Allow-list** a line with `/* rtl-ok: reason */` — only for JS-measured physical geometry (indicators, positioned popovers, ripples, kanban ghost) or glyphs that never mirror (a check mark, a rotated border chevron).
3. **Direction-aware transforms**: `translateX(calc(24px * var(--ac-dir)))`; `--ac-dir` is `1` in LTR and `-1` in RTL (set on `[dir]`). Keyframes that travel also multiply by `--ac-travel` (motion preference).
4. **Directional icons** get `.ac-flip-rtl` (arrows, chevrons pointing "next/back", log-out, panel icons). Trend arrows (`.ac-trend`), pagination and date-picker nav flip automatically. Up/down, plus, check, close never flip.
5. **Measured geometry** (indicators, popovers, tooltips, chart tooltips) is computed in physical px from `getBoundingClientRect()` and placed with `left: 0` + `transform`, so it is correct in both directions without branching. Scroll containers: add `scrollLeft/scrollTop` and subtract `clientLeft/clientTop` (in RTL `clientLeft` includes a left scrollbar). The element that hosts an absolutely positioned indicator must be its containing block.
6. **Placement is logical**: `position(anchor, panel, { placement: 'bottom-start' })` — `start`/`end` resolve per direction (dropdowns align to the trigger's start edge, submenus open toward the inline end, the language picker uses `bottom-end`).
7. **Gestures** read direction: swipe-to-dismiss, drawers, split panes and list swipe actions convert `dx` with the direction sign; arrow keys swap in RTL (`ArrowLeft` = next) for tabs, segmented, charts, date picker, kanban.
8. **Charts** mirror their x-axis in RTL (time runs right → left) through one SVG `matrix(-1 0 0 1 W 0)` on the plot group; text is placed with mirrored x but never mirrored glyphs. The grow-in stagger therefore starts at the start edge in both directions.
9. **Mixed-direction text**: wrap Latin/number runs that must keep their order inside RTL text in `<bdi>` or `.ac-ltr` (`direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate`) — timestamps like `17/04/2026 · 15:45`, card numbers, IBANs, codes, e-mails, file paths. Inside a list whose rows contain names in other scripts, isolate the name (`<bdi dir="rtl">فارسی</bdi>`) so the row keeps the UI's alignment (see the language picker).
10. **Switching language** live: the document crossfades with a blur bridge (`AC.motion.transition(…, { kind: 'lang' })`) — nothing slides while the layout mirrors; indicators re-seat instantly on `ac:i18n:change`.

## Language picker
`<button data-ac="langpicker"></button>` — data from `AC.i18n.languages` (`{ code, name, english, dir, glyph, flag }`; push entries to add languages). Popover on desktop, bottom sheet on phones, search when there are more than 6, keyboard ↑ ↓ Home End + type-ahead, RTL/LTR tag per language, inline-SVG script badge + CSS flag dot (no emoji — they don't render on Windows). Event `ac:langpicker:change { lang, from }`.

## Test coverage (`tests/rtl.mjs`)
Static scan of `src/**/*.css`; in fa and en: document dir, dock side and inset, top-nav order, page-title edge, dropdown anchor, submenu side, flyout side, language picker anchor and row layout, toast corner, sliding highlight exactly on the hovered row (menu, rail), phone tab-bar order, no horizontal overflow at 390 px, tab bar fully on screen, and a live fa → en switch that moves the dock and re-seats the nav pill.
