# Starters

Copy-ready projects live in [`starters/`](../starters). Each has its own README. The repository is also a **GitHub template**: click *Use this template*, then keep the starter you need.

| Starter | Stack | What is included |
|---|---|---|
| [`starters/html`](../starters/html/README.md) | plain HTML + ES modules | App shell (appbar, rail, tab bar), 25-line hash router, 3 pages: dashboard, users, settings |
| [`starters/laravel-blade`](../starters/laravel-blade/README.md) | Laravel 10+ | `layouts/app.blade.php`, partials (appbar, rail, tabbar, powered), 2 example pages, routes, CSRF-aware forms |
| [`starters/nextjs`](../starters/nextjs/README.md) | Next.js App Router | root layout, client `Shell` that loads the framework and re-scans on route change, server-component page |

All starters expect AraminConsole's `dist/` to be copied next to them (`aramin/`, `public/vendor/aramin/`, or `public/aramin/`). They include the small `.ac-powered` credit; remove or replace it if you like (MIT).

## Making your own starter
1. Copy the shell markup from `demo/index.html` (or a starter) and cut it down to your sections.
2. Write pages as `<section class="ac-page">` fragments (no `<script>`).
3. Wire your router/framework to inject the fragment into `#ac-content`; components start automatically, and `AC.scan(root)` re-scans if you render outside the observer's reach.
4. For custom bundles: `node scripts/build.mjs --modules=shell,overlays,forms --out=public/aramin`.

<!-- ===== docs/support-chat.md ===== -->

# Support chat widget

Optional module: `src/modules/support-chat/{support-chat.js,support-chat.css,module.json}` (dependency: `core`).
Demo wiring: `demo/support.js` (one `<script type="module">` in `demo/index.html`; delete both to drop the widget).
Tests: the «support chat» section of `node tests/tickets.mjs`.

```js
await AC.use('support-chat');
const chat = AC.supportChat.init({
  title: 'پشتیبانی آرامین', greeting: 'سلام مریم 👋', subtitle: 'چطور می‌توانیم کمک کنیم؟',
  agents: [{ name: 'سارا احمدی', initials: 'سا', color: 2, online: true }], responseTime: 5,
  color: 'accent' /* or any CSS colour */, position: 'end' /* or 'start' */, online: true,
  welcome: 'سلام! چطور می‌توانم کمک کنم؟', quickReplies: ['پیگیری سفارش', 'بازگشت وجه'], unread: 1,
  articles: [{ id, title, cat, icon, body }], conversations: [{ id, title, preview, time }],
  onSend: async (text, { files, chat }) => ({ text: 'پاسخ ربات', quick: ['صحبت با کارشناس'] }), // or a string, or null
  onOffline: async ({ name, email, message }) => {},
});
chat.open('home' | 'chat' | 'offline'); chat.close(); chat.toggle(); chat.receive({ text, quick }); chat.typing(true);
chat.unread; chat.isOpen; chat.messages; chat.destroy();      // AC.supportChat.open|close|toggle|receive|current
```

## Behaviour
- **Launcher**: floating circle at the bottom inline-end corner (left in RTL; `position: 'start'` mirrors it), above the tab bar
  on phones and tablets; icon cross-fades/rotates to a chevron when open; unread badge bumps (spring) and the launcher wiggles
  when a message arrives while closed. Hidden under pushed phone screens (`html[data-ac-stacked]`) and foreign modal layers.
- **Panel**: Intercom-style, scales in from the launcher corner with a spring (interruptible CSS transition; origin follows
  direction). Esc or outside click minimises; focus returns to the launcher.
  - Home: gradient hero (greeting, team avatars), «new conversation» card with online dot + response time, recent
    conversations, help search (ی/ي and ک/ك insensitive) → article view with «was this helpful?».
  - Conversation: day pill, bubbles (mine = widget colour), typing indicator, read receipts (✓ sent → ✓✓ seen), quick-reply
    chips, attachments, emoji picker, Enter sends (Shift+Enter = new line; on phones Enter is a new line).
  - Offline (`online: false`): name / email / message form → confirmation.
- **Phones (<640px)**: full-screen sheet sliding up (iOS drawer curve), grab handle; drag the header down (or flick) to dismiss;
  page scroll locked while open; navigation closes it.
- Reduced motion: opacity only. Events on `document`: `ac:support-chat:open | close | send {text, files} | receive {text}`.

## Theming / i18n
`--sc-accent` (from `color`, default `--ac-accent`) drives the hero, launcher, my bubbles and chips; everything else is tokens,
so dark mode is automatic. Built-in fa / en / ar strings; override with app keys `sc.<key>` (e.g. `sc.launcher`).

<!-- ===== docs/theming.md ===== -->

# Theming

Every colour, radius, shadow, spacing, and motion value is a CSS custom property named `--ac-*` (defined in `src/css/tokens.css`). Components read only tokens, so a theme is just a set of token overrides. Dark mode works the same way: it swaps tokens.

## Switches on `<html>`

| Attribute | Values | Default | Saved in `localStorage` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-theme` | `light` · `dark` (unset = follow the OS) | `light` | `ac:theme` (`light` / `dark` / `auto`) |
| `data-accent` | `air` · `orange` · `violet` · `blue` · `emerald` · `rose` · `amber` · `slate` | `air` | `ac:accent` |
| `data-density` | `comfortable` · `compact` | `comfortable` | `ac:density` |
| `data-radius` | `sharp` · `default` · `round` | `default` | `ac:radius` |
| `lang` / `dir` | `fa`/`ar` → `rtl`, others → `ltr` | `fa` / `rtl` | `ac:lang` |

`aramin-console-boot.js` applies the saved values before first paint. At runtime:

```js
AC.theme.set({ theme: 'dark', accent: 'blue', density: 'compact', radius: 'round' });
AC.theme.toggle();                       // light ⇄ dark
AC.theme.get();                          // { theme, resolved, accent, density, radius }
document.addEventListener('ac:theme:change', (e) => console.log(e.detail));
```

## Air — the default theme

`air` is the AIR brand preset: Night/Ink navy (`#0F1B28` / `#1B2836`) for primary buttons and the active nav pill, AIR Teal as the accent (`#0B7F8A` in light so white text passes, `#13B5C2` on the navy dark canvas), and **one** amber highlight (`--ac-highlight`: `#F5A524` light / `#FFB020` dark) used only for the notification count and dock dot. Charts: navy, teal, amber. Dark mode uses the navy family for canvas and surfaces.

Contrast (WCAG 2.x): white on light accent 4.75:1; ink button 14.96:1; body text on canvas 15.85:1; muted text 5.23:1 on white; dark: navy on teal 6.97:1, body text on surface 13.74:1, muted 5.05:1.

Switch back to the old look with `data-accent="orange"` (still shipped) or `AC.theme.set({ accent: 'orange' })`; to make it your default, change `accent` in `THEME_DEFAULTS` (`src/js/core.js`), the fallback in `src/js/boot.js` and the `data-accent` on `<html>`. The brand files (logo, favicon, app icons) live in `demo/brand/air/`; the AIR logo is a trademark of AIR and is not under the MIT licence, so replace it with yours when you ship your own brand.

To define your own brand preset, add two blocks to `tokens.css` (or your own CSS loaded after it) — a light one scoped with `:not([data-theme="dark"])` and a dark one — overriding `--ac-accent`, `--ac-accent-2`, `--ac-accent-contrast`, `--ac-ink*`, the neutral surface/text tokens and optionally `--ac-highlight`; then add the name to `theme.accents` and a swatch colour in `customizer.js`.

## Brand your panel

Override tokens after the framework CSS:

```css
/* brand.css — loaded after aramin-console.css */
:root {
  --ac-accent: #0e9f6e;            /* your brand colour */
  --ac-accent-2: #34d399;          /* gradient partner (brand mark, filled KPI, FAB) */
  --ac-font: "Inter", "Vazirmatn", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --ac-r-xl: 18px;                 /* card radius */
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --ac-accent: #31c48d; }
```

Derived tokens (`--ac-accent-soft`, `--ac-accent-ink`, `--ac-accent-hover`, `--ac-ring`) are computed from `--ac-accent` with `color-mix()`, so you rarely need to set them.
Add your own preset with `:root[data-accent="brand"] { --ac-accent: …; --ac-accent-2: …; }` and push `'brand'` to `AC.theme.accents`.

## Token reference

### Colour
| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--ac-bg` | `#f2f2f3` | `#0b0b0c` | page canvas |
| `--ac-bg-subtle` | `#ebebed` | `#111113` | subtle areas |
| `--ac-surface-1` | `#ffffff` | `#161618` | cards, pills |
| `--ac-surface-2` | `#f6f6f7` | `#1c1c1f` | inset panels, KPI tiles |
| `--ac-surface-3` | `#eeeef0` | `#242428` | tracks |
| `--ac-border` / `--ac-border-strong` | `#ececee` / `#dcdce0` | `#232326` / `#313136` | hairlines |
| `--ac-text` / `--ac-text-soft` | `#111113` / `#4b4b52` | light | text |
| `--ac-muted` / `--ac-faint` | `#8b8b93` / `#b6b6bd` | | secondary text |
| `--ac-ink` / `--ac-ink-contrast` | `#111113` / `#fff` | `#fff` / `#0b0b0c` | primary buttons, active pill |
| `--ac-accent` / `--ac-accent-2` | `#f0532d` / `#ff7a4d` | `#f2603b` | accent, gradient |
| `--ac-accent-soft` · `-ink` · `-hover` · `-contrast` | derived | derived | tints, readable accent text, text on accent |
| `--ac-success` · `warning` · `danger` · `info` | `#16a34a` · `#e08a00` · `#e5484d` · `#2f7cf6` | | status (each has `-soft` and `-ink`) |
| `--ac-chart-1..8`, `--ac-chart-grid` | ink, accent, … | | chart series |
| `--ac-glass-bg` · `-strong` · `-border` · `-blur` | | | frosted chrome |
| `--ac-scrim`, `--ac-hover`, `--ac-active` | | | overlays and states |

### Shape, space, and type
| Token | Values |
|---|---|
| `--ac-r-xs … --ac-r-2xl`, `--ac-r-pill` | 6 · 10 · 12 · 16 · 22 · 28px, 999px |
| `--ac-s-0 … --ac-s-12` | 0 to 3rem in 0.25rem steps |
| `--ac-fs-2xs … --ac-fs-4xl` | 0.6875rem to 2.25rem |
| `--ac-lh-tight / snug / normal` | 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.65 |
| `--ac-fw-regular … --ac-fw-black` | 400 to 800 |
| `--ac-shadow-xs … xl`, `--ac-shadow-chrome`, `--ac-shadow-inset` | layered shadows |

### Density-aware metrics
`--ac-control-h` (2.5rem; compact 2.125rem), `--ac-control-h-sm`, `--ac-control-h-lg`, `--ac-control-px`, `--ac-card-pad`, `--ac-row-h`, `--ac-gap`, `--ac-touch` (44px), `--ac-pill-h`.

### Motion
`--ac-ease`, `--ac-ease-out`, `--ac-ease-in`, `--ac-ease-spring`, `--ac-spring` (a `linear()` spring), `--ac-dur-0 … --ac-dur-4` (100 to 300ms). `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` turns motion off everywhere.

### Layout
`--ac-appbar-h`, `--ac-tabbar-h`, `--ac-rail-w`, `--ac-flyout-w`, `--ac-content-max`, `--ac-content-pad`, `--ac-safe-top / bottom / start / end` (safe-area insets).

## Dark mode rules for your own CSS
- Use tokens, never raw colours. If you find yourself writing `:root[data-theme="dark"] .my-thing`, a token is probably missing.
- Text on the accent colour uses `--ac-accent-contrast`; accent-coloured text uses `--ac-accent-ink`.
- `.ac-only-light` / `.ac-only-dark` show content in one theme only (for example, the sun and moon icons).

<!-- ===== docs/tickets.md ===== -->

# Tickets module (help desk)

Optional module: `src/modules/tickets/{tickets.js,tickets.css,module.json}` (dependencies: `table`, `overlays`, `forms`, `apps`).
Load it with `await AC.use('tickets')` (lazy bundle `dist/modules/tickets.js`) or ship it in the full / custom build.
Demo: `#/tickets` (agent inbox), `#/ticket?id=T-1048` (full page), `#/my-tickets` (customer portal), `#/me` (status chips).
Tests: `node tests/tickets.mjs --base=http://localhost:5178`.

## Data shape
```js
{ id: 'T-1048', subject, customer: { name, email, initials, color }, channel: 'email|chat|phone|web',
  category: 'billing|technical|account|sales|shipping|other', priority: 'urgent|high|normal|low',
  status: 'new|open|pending|resolved|closed', assignee: agentId | null, tags: [],
  created, updated, due /* SLA deadline, ISO or null */, slaTotal /* SLA window, minutes */, csat: 1..5 | null,
  messages: [{ id, from: 'customer|agent|note|system', author, text, time, attachments: [{ name, size, type: 'image|pdf|file' }] }] }
// agents: [{ id, name, initials, color, role, online, me }]   canned: [{ id, title, text /* {name} = customer first name */ }]
// macros: [{ id, title, icon, set: { status|priority|assignee }, tag, note, reply /* canned id */ }]
```

## Inbox — `AC.tickets.inbox(el, cfg)`
```js
const inbox = AC.tickets.inbox(el, { tickets, agents, me: 'ar', view: 'all', pageSize: 10 });
inbox.view('overdue'); inbox.add(ticket); inbox.update(ticket); inbox.set(list); inbox.refresh(); inbox.table; inbox.destroy();
el.addEventListener('ac:tickets:open', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); openDrawerOrPush(e.detail.ticket); });
```
Queue views (segmented, live counts, overdue count in red): all · mine · unassigned · overdue. Built on `AC.table`: search,
priority / status / assignee filters, sort (default: nearest SLA first), CSV, row actions (assign to me, close),
bulk actions (assign → agent menu, priority, close). Subject cells link to `#/ticket?id=…`; Ctrl/⌘-click opens the page.
Events: `ac:tickets:open {id, ticket}` (cancelable), `ac:tickets:change {ticket, change}`, `ac:tickets:bulk {action, ids}`.

## Detail — `AC.tickets.detail(el, cfg)`
```js
const d = AC.tickets.detail(el, { ticket, agents, canned, macros, tickets /* for merge */,
  view: 'agent' | 'customer', screen: false, back: false | true | 'close', full: '#/ticket?id=…', title: true, intro: Element });
d.update({ status: 'resolved' }); d.receive(message); d.set(otherTicket); d.destroy();
```
- Thread: customer bubbles (start), agent bubbles (ink, end), **internal notes in yellow** with a lock, centred system events, attachments.
- Composer: «پاسخ به مشتری» / «یادداشت داخلی» tabs, auto-growing textarea, attachments, canned-reply picker (button or `/` on an
  empty composer; popover on desktop, sheet on phones; ↑ ↓ Enter), macros menu, Ctrl+Enter sends, split button «send and set status».
- Sidebar: live SLA timer (HH:MM:SS + progress, at-risk / breached tones), status / priority / assignee, category, channel, tags
  (Enter adds), customer card, CSAT (face + rating) or «request rating», activity log. Every change appends a system event.
- Container-query layout: ≥ 56rem → two columns with a sticky sidebar; narrower (drawer, phone) → the sidebar opens as a sheet («جزئیات»).
- `screen: true` fills its parent (phone pushed screen, drawer, portal) with the composer pinned at the bottom (safe area aware).
  Without `screen`, below 1024px the composer is sticky above the tab bar.
- `view: 'customer'`: notes hidden, perspective flipped, no internal tools, no composer on closed tickets.
- Merge (agent): menu of the customer's other tickets → confirm → messages move, this ticket closes. Event `ac:tickets:merge`.

## Phone push (list → detail)
```html
<div class="ac-split ac-tk-split" data-ac="split">
  <div class="ac-split__pane">…inbox…</div>
  <div class="ac-split__pane ac-tk-screen" data-tk-screen></div>   <!-- hidden on wide screens -->
</div>
```
On `ac:tickets:open`, phones: `AC.tickets.detail(screen, { screen: true, back: true })` + `AC.instance(split,'split').push(1)`;
desktop: `AC.drawer.open({ content, size: 'lg', closeButton: false, className: 'ac-tk-drawer' })` + `detail(…, { back: 'close' })`.

## Other helpers
- `AC.tickets.create({ agents, customer, nextId })` → Promise<ticket | null>: modal (sheet on phones) with category cards, validation.
- `AC.tickets.track(el, ticket)`: customer timeline new → in review → answered → resolved (horizontal ≥ 34rem, vertical below).
- `AC.tickets.sla(due, total)` → `{ text, tone, overdue, ratio }`; `statusChip(s)`, `priorityChip(p)`, `slaChip(ticket)` HTML;
  `<span data-ac="sla" data-due="ISO" data-total="240"></span>` live countdown chip (shared 20 s ticker, ringing alarm when overdue).

## i18n
Built-in fa / en / ar strings; override any with app keys `tickets.<key>` (e.g. `tickets.status.pending`). Numbers use `AC.format`.

<!-- ===== starters/html/README.md ===== -->

# Starter: plain HTML

Single-page admin: app shell (appbar, rail, tab bar), a 25-line hash router and three pages (`dashboard`, `users`, `settings`). No build step.

```bash
cp -r ../../dist ./aramin          # from a clone of AraminConsole (or copy dist/ from a release)
npx serve .                        # any static server; fetch() needs http://, not file://
```

- Add a page: create `pages/<name>.html` (a `<section class="ac-page">` fragment, no `<script>`), then link to `#/<name>`.
- Switch to Persian: set `<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">`.
- The `.ac-powered` credit links to https://air.co.ir/; keep or remove it (MIT).

<!-- ===== starters/laravel-blade/README.md ===== -->

# Starter: Laravel Blade

A layout, four partials, and two example pages. Drop `resources/views/*` into any Laravel 10+ app.

1. Copy AraminConsole into `public/vendor/aramin/`:
   ```bash
   cp -r /path/to/AraminConsole/dist/. public/vendor/aramin/
   ```
2. Copy `resources/views/layouts`, `partials`, `dashboard.blade.php`, `users.blade.php` into your `resources/views/`.
3. Add the two routes from `routes/web.php`.
4. Persian/Arabic: set `APP_LOCALE=fa`; the layout switches `lang` and `dir` for `fa` and `ar`.

Notes
- Pages `@extends('layouts.app')` and fill `@section('content')` with a `<section class="ac-page">`.
- Use `@push('scripts')` for page scripts; the shell does not need a Blade-aware build step.
- AJAX forms: the layout adds the CSRF header on `ac:form:submit`.
- The `.ac-powered` credit (https://air.co.ir/) lives in `partials/powered.blade.php` and the rail; remove or replace it freely (MIT).

<!-- ===== starters/nextjs/README.md ===== -->

# Starter: Next.js (App Router)

```bash
cp -r /path/to/AraminConsole/dist/. public/aramin/
npm install && npm run dev
```

How it fits together
- `app/layout.jsx` loads the boot script and CSS in `<head>` (no flash of wrong theme).
- `components/Shell.jsx` is a client component: it imports the framework once in `useEffect` and re-scans the page on every route change (`usePathname`). The framework also has a MutationObserver, so the re-scan is a safety net.
- Pages are plain markup with `data-ac` attributes and can be server components (`components/Stats.jsx`).
- Keep `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`: the boot script sets `data-theme`, `lang` and `dir` before React hydrates.
- Persian: set `lang="fa" dir="rtl"` on `<html>`.
- The `.ac-powered` credit (https://air.co.ir/) is in `Shell.jsx`; remove or replace it freely (MIT).

<!-- ===== skills/aramin-console/reference/components.md ===== -->

# Class and markup reference (condensed from docs/CONVENTIONS.md)

Naming: `.ac-block`, `.ac-block__element`, `.ac-block--modifier`. State uses ARIA/data attributes: `[aria-selected]`, `[aria-expanded]`, `[aria-current="page"]`, `[data-state="open|closed"]`, `[aria-busy]`, `[disabled]`.

## Atoms
- Buttons `.ac-btn` + `--primary|secondary|outline|accent|soft|ghost|danger|danger-soft|link|gradient` and sizes `--sm|--lg`, `--icon|--square|--block`; groups `.ac-btn-group`; icon button `.ac-iconbtn`.
- Card `.ac-card(__head|__titles|__title|__sub|__actions|__body|__body--flush|__foot)` variants `--flat|inset|glass|interactive|aurora|accent`.
- Stats `.ac-stat(__head|__icon|__label|__value|__unit|__foot|__spark)`, `.ac-trend[data-trend=up|down|flat]`, `.ac-kpis > .ac-kpi`.
- Badges `.ac-badge --accent|success|warning|danger|info|neutral|solid|outline|dot`, `.ac-chip[aria-pressed]`, `.ac-status[data-status]`, `.ac-avatar --xs|sm|lg|xl|gradient [data-color=1..8]`, `.ac-avatar-group`.
- Feedback `.ac-alert`, `progress.ac-progress --success|warning|danger`, `.ac-skeleton(--text|title|circle|block)`, `.ac-empty(__art|__title|__text|__actions)`.
- Lists `.ac-list(__item|__thumb|__main|__title|__meta|__end)(--divided|--inset)`, `.ac-feed(__item|__icon|__body)`, `.ac-divider`.
- Navigation `.ac-tabs(--pills)`, `.ac-segmented(--block|--sm)`, `.ac-breadcrumbs`, `.ac-pagination`, `.ac-stepper(--vertical) > .ac-step[data-state]`.

## Forms
`.ac-form`, `.ac-label`, `.ac-input`, `.ac-select`, `.ac-textarea`, `.ac-input-group`, `.ac-switch`, `.ac-check`, `.ac-radio`, `.ac-field__hint`, `.ac-field__error`. Validation rules (pipe-separated in `data-ac-rules`): `required`, `email`, `min:n`, `max:n`, `iran-mobile`, `iran-national-id`, `sheba`, `url`, `match:#other`.

## Tables
`table.ac-table` (+ `--stack` for phone cards with `td data-label`), or `data-ac="table"` for sorting/filtering/paging/selection/bulk actions.

## Overlays
Modal: `.ac-modal[data-ac=modal] > .ac-dialog > __head(__titles(__title,__sub), __close[data-ac-close]) + __body + __foot`. Sheet/drawer share the pattern. Toasts live in `.ac-toasts`.

## Charts
`.ac-chart-slot(--sm|--lg|--square)[data-ac=chart]`, `.ac-legend`. Types: line, area, bar, donut, gauge, sparkline, heatmap. `labels` may be an array or a generator like `"days:7"`, `"months:12"`.

## Utilities
`ac-stack ac-cluster ac-row ac-spread ac-grow ac-grid(-2/-3/-4) ac-gap-0..8 ac-truncate ac-clamp-2 ac-visually-hidden ac-hide-mobile(<1024) ac-hide-desktop ac-hide-phone(<640) ac-num ac-mono ac-ltr ac-text-(xs|sm|lg|soft|muted|accent|success|warning|danger|start|center|end) ac-stagger ac-animate-in ac-pressable ac-only-light ac-only-dark`.

## Credit
`.ac-powered`: small attribution link, placed at the bottom of the rail (desktop) and the end of content (phones). Optional.

<!-- ===== skills/aramin-console/reference/recipes.md ===== -->

# Recipes (copy, then adapt)

All fragments live inside `main.ac-content` of the shell (see `starters/html`).

## Dashboard
```html
<section class="ac-page" data-page="dashboard">
  <header class="ac-page-head" data-ac="largetitle">
    <div class="ac-page-head__titles"><h1 class="ac-page-head__title" data-i18n="nav.dashboard">داشبورد</h1></div>
    <div class="ac-page-head__actions"><button class="ac-btn ac-btn--primary" type="button">گزارش</button></div>
  </header>
  <div class="ac-bento ac-stagger">
    <div class="ac-card ac-span-xs-6 ac-span-md-4 ac-span-4"><div class="ac-card__body">
      <div class="ac-stat"><span class="ac-stat__label">فروش</span>
        <span class="ac-stat__value" data-ac="counter" data-to="48250000" data-compact>0</span></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="ac-card ac-span-md-12 ac-span-4"><div class="ac-card__body">
      <div class="ac-chart-slot" data-ac="chart" data-ac-config='{"type":"area","labels":"months:12","series":[{"name":"درآمد","data":[5,8,6,9,12,10,14,13,16,15,18,21]}]}'></div>
    </div></div>
  </div>
</section>
```

## CRUD table page
```html
<div class="ac-card"><div class="ac-card__body ac-card__body--flush">
  <div data-ac="table" data-ac-config='{"pageSize":10}'>
    <table>
      <thead><tr><th>نام</th><th data-type="number">موجودی</th><th data-filter="select">وضعیت</th><th data-sortable="false"></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><td>علی</td><td data-value="1200">1,200</td><td>فعال</td>
            <td><button class="ac-btn ac-btn--ghost ac-btn--sm" data-edit="1">ویرایش</button></td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div></div>
<div class="ac-modal" id="edit" data-ac="modal" data-size="md"><div class="ac-dialog">
  <div class="ac-dialog__head"><div class="ac-dialog__titles"><h2 class="ac-dialog__title">ویرایش</h2></div><button class="ac-dialog__close" data-ac-close aria-label="Close"></button></div>
  <form class="ac-dialog__body ac-form ac-stack" data-ac="form"><input class="ac-input" name="name" data-ac-rules="required"></form>
  <div class="ac-dialog__foot"><button class="ac-btn ac-btn--primary" type="submit" form="edit-form">ذخیره</button></div>
</div></div>
```
```js
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target.closest('[data-edit]')) AC.modal.open('#edit'); });
document.addEventListener('ac:table:action', async (e) => { if (await AC.confirm({ title: 'حذف شود؟', tone: 'danger' })) AC.toast.success('حذف شد'); });
document.addEventListener('ac:form:submit', (e) => e.detail.waitUntil(fetch('/api/items', { method: 'POST', body: e.detail.formData })));
```

## Form with Iranian validation
```html
<form class="ac-form ac-stack" data-ac="form" novalidate>
  <label class="ac-label" for="m">موبایل</label>
  <input class="ac-input ac-ltr" id="m" name="mobile" inputmode="tel" data-ac-rules="required|iran-mobile">
  <label class="ac-label" for="n">کد ملی</label>
  <input class="ac-input ac-ltr" id="n" name="national_id" inputmode="numeric" data-ac-rules="required|iran-national-id">
  <label class="ac-label">تاریخ تولد</label>
  <div data-ac="datepicker" data-calendar="persian" data-name="birth"></div>
  <label class="ac-label">شبا</label>
  <div data-ac="sheba" data-name="sheba"></div>
  <label class="ac-label">مبلغ</label>
  <div class="ac-input-group ac-money" data-ac="money" data-name="amount" data-currency="IRT" data-currencies="IRT,IRR"><input class="ac-input"></div>
  <button class="ac-btn ac-btn--primary" type="submit">ثبت</button>
</form>
```

## Official invoice (module `invoice-ir`)
```html
<div data-ac="invoice-ir" data-ac-config='{"type":"proforma","data":{"seller":{"name":"…"},"buyer":{"name":"…"},"items":[{"title":"…","qty":1,"price":1000000}]}}'></div>
```
Fields and types: `docs/invoice-ir.md`.

## Map and picker (module `maps`)
```html
<div data-ac="map" data-center="35.7,51.4" data-zoom="12" data-controls="zoom,locate,search"></div>
<div data-ac="location-picker" data-name="branch"></div>   <!-- posts branch[lat], branch[lng], branch[address] -->
```

## File manager (module `files`)
```html
<div class="my-files" data-ac="files"></div>  <!-- .my-files { block-size: 70vh } in your CSS; adapters: docs/files.md -->
```

## Login page (standalone document)
Copy `demo/auth/login.html` (head with boot script + CSS, body `main.ac-auth`), keep `data-ac="segmented"` email/mobile switch, `data-ac="otp"` for codes, and the `.ac-powered` footer.

<!-- ===== skills/aramin-console/reference/theming-and-modules.md ===== -->

# Theming tokens and modules

## Token groups (`--ac-*`, defined in `src/css/tokens.css`)
- Surfaces: `bg bg-subtle surface-1 surface-2 surface-3 elevated hover active scrim`; lines `border border-strong`; text `text text-soft muted faint`.
- Ink (black primary, white in dark): `ink ink-hover ink-contrast`.
- Accent: `accent accent-2 accent-hover accent-soft accent-ink accent-contrast focus gradient`.
- Status: `success|warning|danger|info` + `-soft` + `-ink`; charts `chart-1..8`.
- Radius `r-xs sm md lg xl 2xl pill`; space `s-0..12` (0.25rem steps); type `fs-2xs … fs-4xl`; shadows `shadow-xs … shadow-xl`.
- Metrics (density-aware): `control-h control-px card-pad row-h gap touch`; motion `ease dur-1..4`.
- Layout: `appbar-h tabbar-h rail-w content-max safe-top/bottom/start/end`.

Override example (brand colour):
```css
:root { --ac-accent: #0a7cff; --ac-accent-2: #5ab0ff; }
```
Dark mode is a token swap: never write `[data-theme=dark] .x` rules; fix the token instead.

## Modules (`node scripts/build.mjs --modules=…`)
`core` (always) · `shell` · `overlays` · `customizer` · `langpicker` · `forms` · `datepicker` · `data-display` · `table` · `chart` · `apps` (kanban, split) · `money` · `chat` · `files` · `invoice-ir` · `mail` · `maps` · `marketing` · `notify` · `prose` · `pwa` · `support-chat` · `terminal` · `tickets` · `uptime` · `user-panel`.
Dependencies are resolved automatically. Lazy-load at runtime: `await AC.use('maps')`. Config file route: `aramin.config.json` with `modules`, `out`, `modulesBase`. See `docs/modules.md`.
